title: Graphic Designer – 27 Swimming Pool Product Sheets (Fixed-Price Project)
description:
Payment: – 50% Upfront / 50% Upon Completion



Job Description



Sensassion Pool & Spa, a swimming pool and hot tub company based in South Florida, USA, is looking for a talented and detail-oriented Graphic Designer to create professional, attractive, and premium-quality product sheets and Microsoft Word documents for our 27 fiberglass swimming pool models.



We are looking for someone who can create beautiful, modern designs while maintaining consistency with our existing company branding.



All necessary materials will be provided. You will not need to take photos or create technical pool diagrams from scratch.



1. Professional Graphic Product Sheets (27 Models)



Create one visually appealing marketing product sheet for each swimming pool model.



Each sheet must include:



* Large, high-quality swimming pool photo

* Pool brand and model name

* Brand logo integrated into the design

* Selling price clearly highlighted (Starting at $XX,XXX)

* Pool dimensions (length, width, depth)

* Water capacity in gallons

* Miniature technical pool diagram showing the pool shape

* Available pool color: White

* Modern, clean, professional, premium-quality layout



These sheets will be used on our website, in marketing materials, and for customer presentations.



2. Editable Microsoft Word Product Documents (27 Models)



Create one fully editable Microsoft Word document (.docx) for each swimming pool model.



Each document must include:



* Pool brand and model name

* Large swimming pool photo

* Miniature technical pool diagram

* Complete pool dimensions (length, width, depth)

* Water capacity in gallons

* Available pool color: White

* Consistent company branding and formatting



Important: We will provide an existing Word document as a reference. You must follow its structure, layout, and overall design to maintain consistency with our current templates.



Selling prices are required on the graphic product sheets only, not on the Word documents.



No PDF creation is required.



3. Materials Provided



We will provide:



* All 27 swimming pool photos

* Technical pool diagrams / miniature illustrations

* Brand and company logos

* Pool model names

* Pool dimensions and gallon capacities

* Selling prices

* Existing Word templates

* Design references and branding guidelines



Your role will focus on professional graphic design, formatting, and accurate presentation of the provided information.



4. Total Deliverables



* 27 professional graphic product sheets

* 27 fully editable Microsoft Word documents

* Editable source files for all graphic designs (Canva, PSD, or AI)



Total: 54 final product files, plus editable graphic source files.



All designs must be consistent, professionally formatted, and ready for use.



5. Requirements



* Strong experience in graphic design

* Experience creating product catalogs, brochures, or product specification sheets

* Proficiency in Canva, Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, or similar software

* Excellent Microsoft Word formatting skills

* Strong attention to detail, especially technical specifications

* Ability to follow existing templates and branding

* Good communication skills

* Ability to meet agreed deadlines



6. Payment Terms



This is a fixed-price project covering all 27 swimming pool models.



Payment will be made in two installments:



* 50% upfront, before starting the project.

* 50% upon completion, after all 27 graphic product sheets, 27 editable Word documents, and graphic source files have been delivered, reviewed, and approved.



The total project price and delivery timeline must be agreed upon before work begins.



7. How to Apply



Please send us:



1. Your portfolio with examples of product sheets, catalogs, or brochures.

2. Your total fixed price for the entire 27-model project.

3. Your estimated completion time.

4. The software you use.

5. Confirmation that you can create fully editable Microsoft Word documents.



We will begin with one sample model to validate the design and layout before proceeding with the remaining 26 models.



We are looking for a reliable, creative, and detail-oriented designer who can deliver beautiful, polished, and professional work.



There may be opportunities for additional design projects in the future.



Sensassion Pool & Spa

description:
Part-Time Meta Ads and Shopify Conversion Specialist (Ecommerce) 

Remote — Philippines | Paid one-month trial

We are a startup online store serving customers in the United States. We’re looking for an experienced Meta ads specialist to find out why our
 and Instagram ads are getting few clicks and no sales, then take action to improve performance.

We already have a team member who creates and posts content. You’ll focus on Meta ads strategy and performance, while working with them on the images, videos, and copy needed for ad campaigns.

What you’ll do

1. Audit our ads and write a report

Review our campaigns, ad creative, targeting, conversion tracking, product pages, and checkout. Deliver a written audit report that explains:

• What the available data shows and what still needs verification.

• The likely reasons for low clicks and no sales.

• The most important fixes, in priority order.

• A practical testing plan for our current $10 – 20/ day ad budget.

Walk us through your findings on a short call.

2. Implement and manage improvements

Make agreed changes, launch focused tests, monitor performance, and adjust based on the results. Work with our content creator on ad images, videos, hooks, and copy. Send a short weekly update covering what you did, what happened, and what you recommend next.

What we’re looking for

• At least 2 years of hands-on Meta ads experience and shopify, including ecommerce campaigns targeting U.S. customers.

• Examples of campaigns you personally managed that generated purchases or improved sales performance.

• Ability to check Meta Pixel, Conversions API, and Purchase event tracking.

• Confidence interpreting impressions, link clicks, CTR, CPC, add to carts, purchases, CPA, and ROAS.

• Someone who can implement solutions and clearly explain results—not just give general advice.









Hours, pay, and trial

This is a paid one-month trial with these expected stages:

• Working hours: 3 hours per day, 5 days per week (15 hours per week).

• Monthly pay: $400

At the end of the first month, we’ll review the work, communication, campaign data, and recommended next steps. Continued part-time work may be agreed month to month if it is a good fit. We expect one short weekly call at a mutually workable time; a regular night shift is not required.

How to apply

Please send:

1. An ecommerce Meta campaign you personally managed, including its budget, what you changed, and the purchase or sales results.

2. What you would check first if our ads get impressions but few link clicks and no sales.

3. How you would test and improve ads with a $10/day budget.

title: Virtual Assistant – Corporate Sales & Events
description:
Join the Number 90 Team – Full-Time Virtual Assistant, Corporate Sales & Events



We’re looking for a highly organised, confident and energetic Full-Time Virtual Assistant based in the Philippines to join the team at Number 90 in Hackney Wick, London.



Number 90 is a vibrant canal-side bar, restaurant and events venue with two nightclub and event spaces. From corporate summer parties and Christmas celebrations to conferences, product launches, private dinners and large-scale events, no two enquiries are quite the same.



You’ll work closely with Marilo, our Corporate Sales Lead, helping us grow our corporate events business and turn new opportunities into confirmed bookings.



- What you'll be doing



This is much more than a traditional admin VA position. You’ll become an important part of our sales and events team, with responsibilities including:



* Supporting corporate enquiries and bookings

* Preparing proposals, contracts and event documentation

* Researching companies and identifying potential new clients

* Building prospect lists and finding new business opportunities

* Cold calling and reaching out to potential corporate clients

* Following up leads and helping move enquiries towards confirmed bookings

* Supporting marketing and sales research

* Keeping our CRM, client information and booking administration organised

* Identifying opportunities to upsell additional event experiences

* Bringing your own ideas for generating leads and growing the business



**Confidence on the phone is essential.** We’re looking for someone who is genuinely comfortable speaking to new people, starting conversations and building relationships. If you enjoy sales and get satisfaction from turning a cold lead into a real opportunity, you’ll enjoy this role.



Who we're looking for



You’ll be a great fit if you are:



* Highly organised and reliable

* Confident, friendly and professional

* An excellent written and verbal English communicator

* Comfortable making outbound calls

* Proactive rather than waiting to be told what to do

* Commercially minded and motivated by results

* Comfortable working independently

* Curious and willing to research companies, industries and opportunities

* Keen to contribute ideas rather than simply complete tasks

* Looking for a stable, long-term role where you can grow with the company



Previous experience in **sales, lead generation, hospitality, events, customer service or business development** would be a strong advantage.



Working hours



This is a **full-time position, 8 hours per day, Monday to Friday**.



Your working day will run through to 4:00 PM UK time, so please consider the corresponding Philippine working hours carefully before applying. We are looking for someone who can commit to this schedule consistently and long-term.



 Why join us?



We want this person to become a genuine member of our team, not simply someone completing tasks remotely.



We already work with four team members based in the Philippines, several of whom have been with us for more than two years. We value people who are dependable, ambitious, committed and willing to take ownership of their work.



There is also real earning potential beyond your base salary. As you develop in the role, you’ll have opportunities to earn additional income through upselling and generating your own event bookings.



Salary & benefits



**Base salary: $600 USD per month**



You'll also receive:



* 13th-month pay, paid in December and pro-rated during your first year

* 20 days of paid holiday per year, inclusive of Philippine public holidays

* Up to 5 paid sick days per year



**After 3 months' probation — or earlier if you're exceeding expectations:**



You'll unlock our bonus scheme.



You can earn commission on event upsells you generate. For example, if you successfully upsell a £200 karaoke add-on, you could earn approximately **£20–£25** from that upsell.



You'll also earn an additional fee for **events you personally generate through your own sales activity**, including cold calling and prospecting. The amount depends on the value of the event, but a strong booking can be worth **$100+ in additional earnings**.



The more opportunities you create, the greater your potential to earn.



**After 6 months:**



You'll unlock **HMO healthcare cover**, funded by the company and renewed every six months.



- Want to know more about Number 90?



Our venues and corporate events can be found here:











### How to apply

**Your Full Name + Your Superpower**

**1. Introduce Yourself**

We don't want a spoken version of your CV — we'd much rather understand your personality and motivation. Please mention your name and today's date in the video.

title: Instagram Outreach & Closing VA – High Performance Bonuses
description:
We are looking for a long-term Instagram Outreach & Closing VA to join our creator management agency.



Your role will be to manage Instagram outreach conversations with potential creators, build rapport naturally, qualify prospects, handle objections, and move qualified leads toward closing.



This is NOT a copy/paste spam position.



We are looking for someone who can actually communicate naturally, understand people, follow a conversation, and know when and how to move toward the next step.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



• Manage outreach conversations on dedicated Instagram accounts

• Start and maintain natural conversations with potential creators

• Qualify leads based on our criteria

• Follow our scripts, SOPs and training

• Handle common questions and objections

• Move qualified prospects toward closing

• Keep track of conversations and follow-ups

• Communicate with the team about important leads and results



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



• Excellent written English

• Natural conversational English — not robotic or overly formal

• Strong communication skills

• Comfortable using Instagram every day

• Sales, appointment-setting or outreach experience is a big plus

• Ability to learn quickly and follow a proven process

• Reliable and consistent

• Honest and trustworthy

• Good attention to detail

• Comfortable working independently



Previous Instagram outreach, sales, appointment-setting, creator management or social media experience is preferred, but we can train the right person.



COMPENSATION



Base pay: $2–$3 USD/hour depending on experience and performance.



The biggest earning opportunity comes from our performance bonus system.



For successfully closed deals, bonuses can range from approximately $200 up to $1,000 per deal depending on the profile and value of the deal.



Our target for a strong outreach VA is approximately 5–10 successful deals per month once fully trained and performing consistently.



Bonuses are performance-based and are not guaranteed. The exact bonus depends on the type and quality of each successfully closed deal.



This means someone who becomes very good at the role can earn significantly more from bonuses than from the hourly base pay.



TRAINING



You will receive:



• Full training

• Outreach scripts

• Conversation examples

• SOPs

• Objection handling frameworks

• Ongoing feedback



We are not looking for someone for a few weeks.



We want to find someone reliable who can learn our system, grow with the agency, take responsibility for multiple Instagram accounts over time, and potentially move into a larger role inside the outreach team.



IMPORTANT



This position is within the online creator management industry and may involve working around 18+ creator accounts/content. Applicants must be 18+ and comfortable working in this industry.



HOW TO APPLY



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Your age

3. Your previous experience with Instagram, outreach, sales or appointment setting

4. Your current availability

5. Why you think you would be good at this role

6. A short voice introduction in English if possible



At the end of your application, write the word "PINK" so we know you read the entire job post.

title: Book Writer / Ghostwriter: Leadership Book Rewrite
description:
About the project

Leading with Heart is looking for a professional writer to rewrite an existing leadership book into a stronger Version 2. The book presents a heart-centered leadership model developed by the authors, Dr. Jeff Kaplan and Dr. Dan Young. The new edition keeps that model at its core and goes further: more research, proper citations, improved graphics, and a book that reads well from the first page to the last.

What the work involves

• Rewriting the existing manuscript as a new book, under the same title or as a second edition

• Researching and citing sources on the leadership problems organizations face today, and on why a heart-centered approach matter

• Drawing on the author's own materials, including findings from our 360-assessment research

• Meeting with the first author to understand his voice, his model and what he wants readers to take away

What we are looking for

• Professional writing experience, with a portfolio of long-form work such as books, ghostwriting or comparable projects

• Original human writing only. We do not accept AI-generated text.

• Strong research skills and accurate, consistent citation

• A good ear for voice, so the finished book sounds like the author

• Nice to have, : a background in psychology, leadership, business, human services or mental health

How we will select

1. Application. Send your portfolio, a short description of your relevant experience and the type of work you have done, your knowledge of the subject, and your expected rate.

2. Screening interview with our team.

3. Meeting with the author. Shortlisted candidates get an overview of the author and the project directly from Dr. Kaplan.

4. Proposal. Each finalist submits a proposal covering what you would do with the book, the specific areas you would focus on, your vision for the finished product, your estimated timeline and your cost. Finalists are evaluated on three factors: vision, experience, and cost.

5. Hiring. The selected writer reads the full manuscript first, then confirms a realistic final timeline. Three working sessions with the author are scheduled after hiring.



How to apply

Please send the following to [application
 or link]:

• Portfolio or writing samples [link]

• A short note on your experience and the kind of work you have done

• Your expected rate for the project

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. We plan to have our finalists identified within two weeks of posting.

title: Video Editor
description:
Video Editor – Short-Form Ads (UGC & High-Energy Edits)

Company: Humbler (
)

Type: Full-time, remote

Pay: $15 per approved video, up to 50 videos per week



About Humbler



Humbler makes men's jewelry built around meaning: pendants, chains, rings, and bracelets inspired by faith, Stoic philosophy, and ancient warrior symbolism. Collections like Memento Mori, Veni Vidi Vici, and St. Michael are daily reminders to stay disciplined, put in the work, and live with purpose. Our ads need to make people feel that, fast.



The Role



We're looking for a fast, creative short-form editor to produce 15–50 ad videos per week for TikTok, Instagram Reels,
, and YouTube Shorts. You'll work from creative briefs we send you, source the clips and audio yourself, and deliver scroll-stopping edits that convert. Every video goes through approval before it's paid and published.



What You'll Do



Edit 15–50 short-form vertical ads per week (typically 10–60 seconds) based on our creative briefs

Find and source b-roll, stock footage, and audio that match each brief and the brand's tone

Edit UGC-style ads that feel native and authentic, like a real customer talking, not a commercial

Create high-paced, cinematic edits with punchy cuts, sound design, speed ramps, beat-synced transitions, and bold text overlays

Write strong hooks in the first 1–3 seconds and keep retention high through the end

Apply Humbler's brand identity consistently: dark, masculine, faith-driven, and motivational, with a premium look that makes the jewelry the hero

Revise edits based on feedback until they're approved

Stay current on short-form trends, ad formats, and what's performing in the men's lifestyle and motivation space



What You Need



A portfolio of short-form ads or social content, with examples of both UGC-style and high-energy edits

Strong skills in Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci Resolve, or similar

Proven ability to work fast without sacrificing quality at high weekly volume

A sharp eye for hooks, pacing, and what makes people stop scrolling

Understanding of commercial licensing for music and footage (e.g., TikTok Commercial Music Library, licensed stock sites); ads can't use unlicensed trending audio

Reliable communication and the ability to hit deadlines consistently

Ability to take a brief and run with it, and to take feedback without ego



Nice to Have



Experience editing for DTC or e-commerce brands

Familiarity with paid social performance metrics (hook rate, CTR, ROAS)

Motion graphics and animated text skills

An eye for making product shots look premium (lighting, macro detail, gold/silver shine)



Compensation



$15 per approved video

Up to 50 videos per week (up to $750/week)

Videos are paid once approved; revisions are part of the process



How to Apply



Send your portfolio with at least 3 short-form ads (ideally one UGC-style and one high-energy edit), your preferred editing software, and how many videos you can realistically turn around per week.

title: Graphic Designer (Adobe Photoshop Canvas Production)
description:
We are looking for a fast, detail-oriented, and highly creative Graphic Designer & Photo-Manipulator with elite, manual Adobe Photoshop skills and experience in high-volume print production.



This is not an AI prompting role. We require a true digital artist who can take complex, highly personalized customer briefs, specifically a collection of multiple individual images representing a customer's dreams, goals, and visions, and manually stitch, blend, and paint them into a single, breathtaking, cohesive graphic optimized for high-resolution canvas printing.



This role is ideal for a Photoshop expert who thrives in a fast-paced environment and can deliver masterpiece-level, high-resolution outputs at scale using traditional digital compositing techniques.



Key Responsibilities



• Print-Ready Optimization: Prepare all final graphics to strict print-on-demand specifications (300+ DPI/high resolution, correct color profiles, bleed lines for canvas gallery wrapping).

• E-Commerce Visuals: Design complementary product mockups, launch banners, and promotional graphics showcasing the final canvas prints in realistic home settings.

• Volume Production: Maintain a consistent, rapid daily output of finalized print files without sacrificing the emotional and artistic depth of the customer's vision.





Qualifications & Skills



• Mastery of Adobe Photoshop: Absolute expertise in advanced masking, layers, blending modes, color grading, and manual digital brushwork.

• Elite Photo-Manipulation Portfolio: Proven experience in digital collage, matte painting, or advanced photo manipulation. You must be able to prove you can make completely different images look like they belong in the same artwork without relying on AI.

• Print Production Knowledge: Deep understanding of resolution constraints, CMYK vs. RGB color spaces, canvas wrapping constraints, and bleed lines.

• An Eye for Detail & Composition: Strong understanding of visual hierarchy, focal points, perspective, and lighting.





How to Apply



If you have the Photoshop skills and are ready to create meaningful, high-quality art at scale, we want to hear from you!





Please send your resume along with a short note on your graphic design experience and the platforms you've used. Let us know your availability (part-time or full-time) and preferred working hours.

title: AI Automation Engineer & Coach — Part-Time ($2,000/month)
description:
I use AI daily for business operations, sales follow-ups, research, content creation, and brand partnerships. I am looking for an experienced AI automation engineer who enjoys teaching and can help me become much better at using AI while building useful systems with me.



The goal is practical: improve real workflows, explain your decisions clearly, and help me learn to maintain and improve what we build.



ROLE AND SCHEDULE

- Remote, part-time: approximately 15 hours per week.

- Compensation: $2,000 USD per month for the agreed schedule.

- Start with a 30-day paid trial, with the possibility of an ongoing role based on results and mutual fit.

- Include two one-hour live working/teaching sessions each week within the 15 hours, at mutually agreed times compatible with US Eastern Time.

- Remaining hours are flexible and focused on building, testing, documentation, and support. Additional hours and software costs must be agreed in advance.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Review how I currently use AI and identify the highest-value improvements.

- Build reliable workflows for business information, sales follow-ups, content research and repurposing, and brand-partnership tracking. We will prioritize a small number of projects together.

- Connect tools and data using APIs, scripts, and platforms such as n8n, Make, or Zapier when appropriate.

- Teach me how to give AI better context, choose suitable tools, evaluate outputs, troubleshoot failures, and make changes independently.

- Use AI coding tools such as Codex or Claude Code where useful, and explain the code and decisions in plain English.

- Document each system with clear instructions, short walkthroughs, and a plan for maintenance.



FIRST 30 DAYS

- Assess existing workflows and agree on two achievable, valuable projects.

- Deliver and test those two workflows, documenting their limits and the improvement over the current process.

- Run regular hands-on lessons using the actual projects.

- Help me independently make and test a small change to at least one workflow.



WHAT YOU SHOULD BRING

- Evidence of working AI automations or integrations that you personally built and maintained.

- Practical programming ability in Python or JavaScript/TypeScript, plus experience with APIs and at least one automation platform.

- Strong spoken and written English and the patience to teach a non-engineer without unnecessary jargon.

- Good judgment about when a simple process is enough and when AI adds value.

- Experience handling missing data, unreliable model outputs, duplicate actions, failed integrations, and ongoing costs.

- Care with access permissions and private data. Keep separate businesses' information separate, and use approval steps before external messages, publishing, or consequential changes.



HOW TO APPLY

Please apply through OnlineJobs.ph and include:

1. Two relevant systems you built: the problem, what you personally implemented, tools used, and what improved. Share a portfolio or sanitized demo if available; do not share client secrets.

2. A short 3–5 minute screen recording explaining an existing workflow you built, including one failure you encountered and how you fixed it. Teach it as if I were your client.

3. One improvement you would investigate first for someone using AI across business operations and content, and how you would check whether it worked.

4. Your weekly availability, possible live-session times in US Eastern Time, start date, and confirmation that the compensation and schedule fit.



Shortlisted applicants will have a practical conversation and may be invited to a small paid exercise, with scope and fee agreed in advance. We will assess implementation ability, teaching clarity, reliability, and communication. Please be ready to explain and modify your own work; AI-assisted work is welcome.

Develop repeatable systems for generating approximately 12–15 visual/video segments per course.



Maintain consistent branding and imagery across different courses.



Build efficient production processes for digital courses, workbooks, and personal development programs.



Coordinate technical workflows with our existing Kajabi specialist.



4. AI Marketing & Advertising



Develop AI-assisted SEO and website optimization workflows.



Automate content creation for social media and marketing.



Explore AI systems for Meta advertising, ad creation, campaign tracking, and performance analysis.



Develop lead generation,
 marketing, and customer engagement automations.



5. AI Systems Integration & Automation



Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Google Workspace, Kajabi, and other business applications where appropriate.



Build AI agents and automated workflows using tools such as n8n, Make, Zapier, APIs, and webhooks.



Research and recommend the most cost-effective tools and software.



Determine when existing software is preferable to custom-built solutions.



Document systems so they can be maintained and expanded as the business grows.



Required Skills



Advanced experience with Claude, ChatGPT, and AI agent development.



Strong proficiency in n8n, Make, Zapier, or similar automation platforms.



Experience with API integrations, webhooks, and workflow automation.



Ability to build AI knowledge management systems and dashboards.



Strong technical problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.



Experience implementing reliable, practical AI solutions for businesses.



Ability to independently research, recommend, and implement technology.



Excellent English communication and project management skills.



Experience with Kajabi, AI video generation, SEO, Meta Ads, and online education platforms is an advantage.



What We're Looking For



We want someone who can take an idea and turn it into a functioning system.



For example, we may say:



"I want to upload a completed course script and have AI automatically prepare the branded visuals, voiceovers, video segments, and materials needed for publication."



We need someone who can evaluate the options, explain the best approach, recommend the necessary tools, and build the solution.



We value someone who is proactive, resourceful, organized, and comfortable taking ownership of a project from beginning to completion.



Project Structure & Compensation



We will begin with a paid trial project.



The initial project will be agreed upon in advance, with clearly defined deliverables, timelines, and payment milestones.



Upon satisfactory completion of the first project, we will offer another project. We intend to continue working this way, assigning and paying for individual projects as they are successfully completed.



Our goal is to establish a long-term working relationship with a skilled AI specialist who can progressively build and manage our AI infrastructure.



Some projects will involve one-time system development, while others may lead to ongoing automation management, optimization, and technical support.



We are open to working with one highly skilled individual or a small team with complementary expertise.



How to Apply

Proposal: Describe what you could realistically deliver within a $250 CAD project budget.



Availability and pricing: Include your hourly rate, availability, and preferred project pricing.



Important: We are specifically seeking someone with hands-on AI development and automation experience, not someone whose primary experience is basic ChatGPT prompting or administrative VA work.



Please begin your application with the words "AI Systems Builder" to confirm you have read the complete posting.



We look forward to finding a talented technical partner to help us build a highly automated, efficient, and scalable business.



We cant wait to meet you!!

title: E-Commerce Video Editor (AI B-ROLL AND CHARACTERS)
description:
QUICK SUMMARY



Daily Output: 3–4 concepts per day including revisions

Video Length: Typically 60–200 seconds

Focus: High-converting product ads using a mix of AI-enhanced and traditional editing workflows

Location: Remote

Pay: $10 per completed minute of video for the first month → $15 per completed minute from the second month onwards

Bonus Scheme: Up to $1,000 for winning ads based on performance



ABOUT THE ROLE



We are looking for a high-level AI Video Editor / Creative who understands direct response advertising, premium product cinematography and fast-paced content production.



This role is not purely AI-generated content.



While AI-generated b-roll and AI workflows will be used at the start to increase speed and scale, our long-term expectation is that concepts will typically contain only around 10–20% AI-generated footage, with the remaining majority being traditional high-quality b-roll, stock integration, motion graphics, editing and polished ad creative techniques.



We expect 3–4 strong concepts per day, including revisions and iteration based on feedback.



Speed matters, but realism, conversion quality, pacing and attention to detail matter more.



You should understand how to create ads that feel premium, believable, emotionally engaging and performance-driven — not generic “AI-looking” content.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Daily Concept Production

Produce 3–4 ad concepts daily ranging from 60–200 seconds, including revisions and improvements based on feedback.



AI-Assisted Product Cinematography

Generate ultra-realistic AI product b-roll when needed, including clean lighting, realistic textures, cinematic camera movement and seamless integration into real-world edits.



Traditional Editing & B-Roll Integration

Work heavily with real footage, stock footage, motion design, pacing, transitions, subtitles, sound design and conversion-focused editing techniques to create polished final ads.



AI Character & Voice Integration

Create and manage realistic AI talking characters, lip-syncing, voiceovers and emotional delivery when required.



End-to-End Post Production

Handle scripting support, prompting, editing, upscaling, sound design, colour grading, pacing, revisions and final export delivery.



REQUIRED TECHNICAL STACK



You should already be highly experienced with most of the following tools:



AI Video Generation



Runway Gen-3 / Gen-4

Kling

Luma Dream Machine



Voice / Character Tools



HeyGen

ElevenLabs

D-ID



Image Generation



Midjourney v6+

Leonardo.ai



Editing & Post Production



Adobe Premiere Pro

DaVinci Resolve

CapCut Desktop



AI Enhancement



Topaz Video AI

REQUIREMENTS



Speed & Efficiency

You must be capable of turning concepts into polished deliverables quickly while maintaining quality and realism.



Understanding of Advertising

You should understand engaging shots, pacing, hooks, retention editing, emotional storytelling and what makes ads convert.



Attention to Detail

You must be able to identify and fix bad AI outputs, unrealistic movement, awkward lip-syncing, poor lighting, incorrect accents, unnatural emotion or low-quality visual details.



Strong English & Audio Awareness

Do not apply if you cannot clearly distinguish between British and American accents, create emotionally accurate AI voiceovers or direct voice delivery properly.



Work Ethic & Communication

Communication, reliability, speed and consistency are critical. This is a high-performance environment with high expectations.



PAY



Compensation is based on completed video output.



First Month

$10 per completed minute of video



Second Month Onwards

$15 per completed minute of video



The more completed video work you produce, the more you can earn.



BONUS SCHEME FOR WINNING ADS



On top of the normal per-minute pay, there are additional bonuses for ads you create that become winning ads.



$200 Winning Ad Bonus

Any winning ad spending over $200 per day at a 1.8 ROAS or above = $200 bonus



$1,000 Winning Ad Bonus

Any winning ad spending $1,000 per day at a 2.0 ROAS or above = $1,000 bonus



These bonuses are paid on top of your normal per-minute video compensation.



HOW TO APPLY



Please provide:



A portfolio or folder showcasing your best AI-assisted video work and product ad creatives

Examples of product b-roll and/or talking character content

A list of the AI tools you currently use or pay for regularly



Application Requirement



To prove you have strong attention to detail, start your application or cover letter with the secret word:



NEURAL

title: Hiring: Performance Creative Localization Specialist (E-commerce / Dropshipping)
description:
**Full-Time | Remote | Long-Term | $900 Base + $200 Performance Bonus**



We are looking for a highly skilled **Creative Localization Specialist** to join our fast-paced e-commerce team.



We launch 5–6 product funnels daily across multiple international markets and need someone who can consistently deliver high-quality, fully localized video ads and static creatives.



**This is NOT a basic video editing, translation, or AI automation position.**



Your job is to take existing competitor creatives (UGC videos, video ads, static images, etc.) and professionally recreate and localize them for our target markets.



The final result should look and sound like it was originally created for that specific market.



## Responsibilities



- Localize UGC videos, video ads, and static image creatives into different target languages.

- Accurately translate and replace ALL on-screen text, subtitles, headlines, and CTAs.

- Replace foreign-language voiceovers with realistic, native-sounding AI voiceovers.

- Ensure perfect voiceover timing, pacing, synchronization, and natural delivery.

- Adapt translations to sound natural and persuasive while preserving the original marketing angle.

- Professionally remove and replace embedded text without damaging backgrounds or reducing visual quality.

- Maintain the original creative's structure, design, emotional impact, and conversion-focused messaging.

- Handle daily creative production for 5–6 product funnels.

- Independently review and quality-check every creative before submission.

- Deliver organized, launch-ready assets within strict deadlines.



## Requirements



- Proven experience with **direct-response e-commerce / dropshipping creatives**.

- Strong experience with AI dubbing, voiceovers, and localization tools.

- Ability to manually edit, mask, track, reconstruct, and replace elements when automated tools fail.

- Strong understanding of hooks, CTAs, marketing psychology, and conversion-focused advertising.

- Excellent attention to detail and ability to spot even minor mistakes.

- Ability to verify translations for accuracy, naturalness, and cultural relevance.

- Fast turnaround times without sacrificing quality.

- Excellent time management, communication, and reliability.

- Ability to work independently without constant supervision.



## IMPORTANT — We Are NOT Looking for AI Button Clickers



If your only skill is uploading a video into an AI tool, clicking "Translate," and exporting the result, **DO NOT APPLY.**



We actively use AI tools to improve speed and efficiency, but you must have the technical skills to manually fix anything AI gets wrong.



You must be capable of:



- Manually recreating embedded text while preserving the original design.

- Fixing inaccurate translations and unnatural voiceovers.

- Handling complex videos where automated AI editing fails.

- Correcting tracking, masking, timing, and synchronization issues.

- Identifying and solving problems independently.

- Delivering professional results without relying entirely on one-click AI solutions.



**We hire for real skills, precision, and problem-solving ability — not for knowing how to operate AI tools.**



## Strict Quality Standards



We expect professional, launch-ready work with:



- Zero spelling mistakes or incorrect translations.

- No robotic or unnatural voiceovers.

- No missing or untranslated foreign-language text.

- No visible editing mistakes or poorly replaced text.

- Accurate synchronization between audio, subtitles, and visuals.

- No unnecessary loss of video or image quality.

- Consistent delivery within agreed deadlines.



Every submitted creative is subject to quality control.



Repeated avoidable mistakes, failure to correct errors, or consistently poor performance will result in a formal performance review and may lead to termination.



We expect someone who takes full ownership of their work and checks everything carefully before submitting.



## Salary & Opportunity



**$900/month base salary + up to $100/month performance bonus.**



The monthly bonus is based on quality, accuracy, reliability, and delivery performance against agreed standards.



This is a full-time, long-term position with consistent daily work and the opportunity to grow with our e-commerce operation.



## How to Apply



Please provide ALL of the following:



1. Your portfolio with examples of localized video ads and static creatives.

2. At least **2 before-and-after examples** showing the original creative and your localized version.

3. A **30–60 second screen recording** demonstrating how you manually fix a difficult editing or localization issue that AI couldn't solve properly.

4. The editing software and AI tools you use.

5. Your average turnaround time for one UGC video and one static image.

6. Your experience working with direct-response e-commerce or dropshipping brands.

7. Your availability and confirmation that you accept the stated compensation structure.



### Mandatory Application Instructions



Start your application with the exact words "Manual Skills First".



Applications missing this phrase, the required portfolio examples, or the screen recording will not be considered.



Shortlisted candidates will complete a **paid practical test** involving video localization, static creative localization, and manual editing.



We are looking for a serious, highly skilled, detail-oriented specialist who can consistently deliver exceptional work at scale.



**If that's you, we'd love to see your work.**

title: Supply Chain Manager (Shopify/E-commerce)

title: DTC AI Video Editor
description:
The Role



We're looking for a DTC AI Video Editor with proven experience working with 7-, 8- or 9-figure e-commerce brands.



You need to understand direct response, not just editing.



Our creative strategists will provide the script, angle and brief — roughly 50% of the ad. Your job is to own the other 50%:



- Choose the strongest footage from our B-roll library.

- Identify where the concept needs stronger or more specific visuals.

- Generate new AI content when existing footage isn't good enough.

- Make every visual congruent with the script, hook and emotional beat.

- Edit for attention, clarity, retention and conversion.

- Proactively improve the visual concept rather than simply executing instructions.



The goal isn't to make videos that look good. The goal is to make ads that perform.



What You'll Own



You'll be responsible for producing a minimum of 12–15 finished concepts per week, with some concepts requiring original AI content generation.



Your responsibilities will include:



- Editing short-form DTC direct-response ads across multiple formats.

- Translating scripts and briefs into strong visual narratives.

- Selecting B-roll based on the psychology and intent of each line.

- Generating missing visuals using AI rather than settling for weak footage.

- Creating high-quality AI UGC, animation and other AI-native creative formats.

- Using tools/models such as Higgsfield, Seedance and Kling to a professional standard.

- Building strong hooks, pattern interrupts, pacing and visual escalation.

- Maintaining script-to-visual congruence throughout every creative.

- Finding ways to increase viewer retention without distracting from the sales message.

- Bringing new visual ideas to the creative strategists.

- Learning from winning and losing ads and improving future execution accordingly.

- Taking ownership of the finished creative rather than waiting to be told exactly what to do.



Who We're Looking For



Non-negotiables



- Proven video-editing experience with successful DTC/e-commerce brands, ideally at 7-, 8- or 9-figure scale.

- Strong knowledge of direct-response advertising fundamentals.

- A portfolio demonstrating performance-focused paid social creative — not only polished brand content.

- High-level AI content generation ability.

- Hands-on experience with modern AI video workflows, ideally including Higgsfield, Seedance and Kling.

- Ability to create convincing AI UGC, animation and other visual formats.

- Strong instinct for matching visuals to copy.

- Understanding of hooks, pacing, pattern interrupts, curiosity, emotion, proof and retention.

- Ability to work at volume without allowing quality to collapse.

- Comfortable receiving a brief and independently solving visual problems.



The mindset



We're looking for someone who is:



- Obsessed with getting better.

- Extremely motivated.

- Proactive rather than reactive.

- Comfortable taking ownership.

- Curious about why an ad works, not merely how it was edited.

- Hungry to become an elite direct-response marketer, not just an editor.

- Excited by a fast-moving environment where standards continue to rise.



If you need every visual decision mapped out for you before you can start editing, this isn't the right role.



What Great Looks Like



A great editor on our team doesn't read a line in a script and ask:



> "What clip should I put here?"

> 



They ask:



> "What does the viewer need to see here for this line to hit as hard as possible?"

> 



If the right clip exists in the B-roll folder, use it.



If it doesn't, create it.



If the brief can be made stronger visually, say so and improve it.



You should be thinking about:



- What stops the scroll?

- Does the first visual strengthen the hook?

- Is every shot supporting what the voiceover is saying?

- Where could attention drop?

- Can this claim be demonstrated instead of stated?

- Is there a stronger visual proof?

- Does the edit build desire, belief or curiosity with every beat?

- What could we generate that would make this concept substantially stronger?



AI Capability



AI generation is a core part of this role — not an optional extra.



You should be comfortable generating production-ready creative across formats such as:



- AI UGC

- Character-led scenes

- Product-integrated scenes

- Cinematic B-roll

- Animations

- Visual metaphors

- Scroll-stopping hook visuals

- Scenes that would be difficult or expensive to shoot traditionally



We want to see real examples of your AI work and understand which tools/models you used to produce them.



Output & Working Rhythm



- Minimum 12–15 concepts per week.

- Mix of traditional editing and AI-assisted/generated concepts.

- Fast iteration based on creative feedback and performance learnings.

- Consistent communication with our creative strategists.

- High standards for both speed and execution.



We care about output, but volume without quality is not the goal. We want someone capable of building a repeatable workflow that delivers both.



Growth Opportunity



This is intended to be a long-term position.



For the right person, there is a clear opportunity to grow into:



- Lead Video Editor, taking ownership of editing standards and potentially helping develop other editors.

- Creative Strategist, if you develop strong enough direct-response, research and concepting ability.



We'll actively coach and train you in direct response while you work with us. We want someone who wants to compound their skill set and become a significantly stronger marketer over time.



Team Environment



You'll be joining a fast-growing DTC e-commerce brand with a highly driven team.



We're ambitious about where we're taking the brand, and creative is one of the most important growth levers in the business.



That means this role comes with real ownership and real expectations.



Only apply if you're genuinely excited by a fast-moving, high-performance environment and want to take responsibility for an area that directly impacts the growth of the company.



Application Process



Start your application with the word “STRATEGIST”



If your application doesn't begin with that word, we'll assume you haven't read the full brief.



Then include:



- A short introduction and the DTC brands you've worked with.

- Links to your 3–5 strongest direct-response ads.

title: OUTBOUND SALES REPRESENTATIVE – US MARKET
description:
Hi! We’re a growing agency that supports therapy clinics across the United States with their operations, staffing, and marketing.



We’re looking for a confident, driven Sales Representative to join our team long-term.



This is NOT a general VA position.

This is a sales role.



You will be responsible for getting in front of US therapy clinic owners, starting conversations, understanding their needs, qualifying opportunities, handling objections, and booking qualified meetings with our founders.



🎯 THE ROLE



Your primary goal is simple:



Generate qualified sales opportunities for our agency.



You will be the first point of contact between our company and potential clients.



You'll be speaking directly with US-based ABA and speech therapy clinic owners and decision-makers, so confidence, communication skills, and the ability to sell are extremely important.



You will not be responsible for closing the final deal or negotiating pricing. Your job is to create the opportunity and get the qualified prospect onto our founder's calendar.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



📞 Make outbound cold calls to US-based therapy clinics



💬 Speak confidently with business owners and decision-makers



🎯 Identify potential clients and qualify their needs



🧠 Understand basic pain points and communicate how our agency can help



🔥 Handle objections and keep conversations moving



📅 Book qualified sales meetings directly onto our founder's calendar



📧 Follow up with prospects through email and LinkedIn



🔁 Follow up consistently with prospects who aren't ready immediately



📊 Track calls, conversations, follow-ups and outcomes in our CRM



📈 Work toward daily and weekly sales/outreach targets



🤝 Participate in a short daily team stand-up



THIS IS A SALES ROLE! NOT A VA ROLE!



We're specifically looking for someone who enjoys sales.



If you're someone who:



Gets excited by hitting targets

Doesn't mind making lots of calls

Can confidently speak to business owners

Knows how to handle rejection

Can think on their feet

Enjoys persuasion and negotiation

Wants to build a career in sales



We want to hear from you.



If you're primarily looking for data entry, admin, calendar management, or general VA work, this won't be the right position for you.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Required:



1–3+ years of experience in B2B sales, outbound sales, cold calling, SDR, business development, or lead generation

Excellent spoken English

Confident and natural communication style

Experience speaking with business owners or decision-makers

Strong objection-handling skills

Comfortable with high-volume outbound calling

Goal-oriented and motivated by KPIs

Excellent follow-up skills

Strong written communication

Comfortable using CRM systems

Reliable internet connection with a backup

Quiet, professional workspace

Quality headset

Willingness to work US Eastern Time hours

💪 YOU NEED TO BE COMFORTABLE WITH REJECTION



Let's be honest:

You're going to hear "no." A lot.



That's sales.

We're looking for someone who doesn't take rejection personally and can pick up the next call with the same energy.



You need to be resilient, competitive, coachable and hungry to improve.



💰 WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive monthly salary based on experience

Performance bonuses/commission opportunities

Paid training

Sales scripts and proven processes

Training on the ABA/therapy industry

Direct access to the founders

Small team with minimal bureaucracy

Long-term stability

Opportunity to grow into a Senior Sales / Team Lead position



We want someone who can grow with us — not someone who is simply looking for their next short-term VA job.



🌎 WORKING HOURS

You will be working with US-based businesses, so you must be comfortable working US Eastern Time hours.

This means night-shift work for someone based in the Philippines.



We pay a premium for this schedule because we understand that working US hours is a significant commitment.



🎙️ HOW TO APPLY

Please send us:



1. Your CV

2. A 60-second voice recording introducing yourself and telling us about the hardest sales prospect or objection you've ever handled.

3. Your expected monthly salary

4. Tell us briefly about your outbound sales experience.

How many calls were you typically making per day, and what type of businesses were you selling to?



🚨 IMPORTANT

Put SALES in the subject line.

Applications without a voice recording will NOT be reviewed.

We're looking for someone who wants to build a career in sales, grow with our company, and become a key member of the team.

If you're hungry, confident, competitive and ready to sell! APPLY!
salary: $600 plus a bonus per meeting booked

title: Senior Accountant – Xero/XPM | NZ Accounting & Property Tax Practice
description:
Senior Accountant – Xero/XPM | NZ Accounting & Property Tax Practice



Location: Philippines (remote)  

Hours: Full-time preferred (40 hours per week), with a 4-day-per-week arrangement considered for the right person  

Experience: Minimum 5 years; ideally 10+ years in accounting/bookkeeping or public practice  

Start: As soon as possible  



About MyTaxMate (
)



MyTaxMate is a growing New Zealand accounting and tax advisory practice. We work with individuals, small businesses, companies, trusts, Look-Through Companies (LTCs), and property investors.



A significant part of our work involves residential rental properties, property structures, GST, annual accounts, income tax returns, payroll, and client support. We are not a high-volume compliance factory. We value accurate work, practical thinking, clear communication, and building long-term client relationships.



We are looking for an experienced Senior Accountant who can become a trusted part of the team, initially managing accounting and compliance work and progressively taking greater ownership of client communication and job management.



The role



You will prepare and manage work across a portfolio of New Zealand clients. This will include accounting, reconciliations, GST, annual accounts, tax-return preparation, rental-property accounts, document follow-up, and communicating with clients.



You must be comfortable working independently, identifying issues rather than simply processing information, and escalating technical or judgment-based matters when needed.



Over time, we want this role to take more responsibility for client contact, including requesting information, following up outstanding queries, explaining routine accounting matters in plain English, and keeping jobs moving.



Key responsibilities



- Manage a portfolio of client jobs from information collection through to review.

- Reconcile Xero files, including bank, credit-card, loan, shareholder-current-account, and clearing accounts.

- Prepare draft GST returns and identify transactions requiring client clarification.

- Prepare annual financial statements, working papers, and draft income tax returns.

- Prepare rental-property accounts for individuals, joint owners, companies, LTCs and trusts.

- Allocate and review property income and expenses, including rent, interest, rates, insurance, property-management fees, repairs and maintenance, legal costs, chattels and depreciation.

- Assist with company, trust and LTC accounting work.

- Review transactions for business versus private treatment and GST treatment.

- Prepare clear client query lists and follow up clients for outstanding information.

- Maintain accurate job status, budgets, notes and deadlines in Xero Practice Manager (XPM).

- Assist with payroll, PAYE, bookkeeping and routine administration where required.

- Prepare professional draft
s to clients and respond to routine client queries.

- Identify missing information, unusual movements, duplicate transactions, coding issues and potential tax/accounting risks.

- Work closely with the founder on complex tax, property, structuring and IRD matters.



Essential requirements



- At least 5 years’ accounting experience, preferably in an accounting firm or outsourced accounting environment.

- Ideally 10+ years’ experience.

- Strong practical experience using:

  - Xero

  - Xero Practice Manager (XPM)

  - Microsoft Excel and Word

  - Google Workspace, including Gmail, Google Drive and Google Sheets

- Experience preparing financial statements, workpapers, GST returns and income tax returns.

- Excellent bank reconciliation and bookkeeping skills.

- Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally with clients.

- Ability to manage several jobs at once, prioritise deadlines and follow up without being chased.

- High attention to detail and a strong review mindset.

- Comfortable asking sensible questions and raising issues early.

- Reliable internet, suitable home-office setup and availability during New Zealand business hours, at least partly.



Preferred experience



The following is highly desirable, but we are also happy to train the right experienced accountant:



- Experience with New Zealand accounting, tax or compliance work.

- Experience with Xero Tax.

- Knowledge of New Zealand GST, PAYE, provisional tax and IRD processes.

- Experience preparing accounts for New Zealand rental properties or property investors.

- Familiarity with New Zealand property-tax concepts, including interest deductibility, residential rental-loss ring-fencing, ownership structures, LTCs, trusts, companies, depreciation and GST considerations.

- Experience dealing directly with clients by
 or video call.

- Experience with Ignition, myIR, Google Forms, Calendly or similar practice-management tools.

- Experience working with Australian or New Zealand accounting firms.



You will suit this role if you are someone who:



- Takes ownership of your work and follows matters through to completion.

- Does not guess when information is unclear.

- Can distinguish between routine work and matters that need review.

- Enjoys dealing with clients professionally and building trust.

- Is organised, calm under deadlines and commercially aware.

- Can prepare work to a high standard before sending it for review.

- Wants a long-term role where your responsibility and client exposure can grow.



What we offer



- Long-term remote role with a growing New Zealand accounting practice.

- Full-time role preferred, with four days per week considered for the right candidate.

- Opportunity to develop into a senior client-management role.

- Direct exposure to NZ accounting, tax, property-investment and advisory work.

- Support and training on our systems, processes and New Zealand-specific requirements.

- A professional but friendly working environment where good work and initiative are valued.

- Competitive remuneration based on experience, capability and hours worked.



How to apply



Please apply with:



1. Your CV/resume.

2. A short cover letter explaining your experience with Xero, XPM and client communication.

3. Details of your experience preparing financial statements, GST returns and income tax returns.

4. Any New Zealand or Australian accounting/tax experience.

5. Your preferred working arrangement: full-time or four days per week.

6. Your expected monthly salary in PHP.

7. Your internet speed and usual availability in New Zealand business hours.

8. A brief answer to this question:

When reviewing a Xero file before preparing a GST return or annual accounts, what are the first five things you would check?



Please begin your application with the words: “Detail matters.” This helps us identify applicants who have read the full advertisement.



Only applicants with strong Xero experience, excellent English, and genuine senior-accounting capability will be considered.

title: INSTAGRAM OUTREACH: EXPERIENCED SALES PROFESSIONAL / RAINMAKER WANTED
description:
$5/hour + $200–$400 per paying client + consultation and renewal bonuses



Part-time | Remote | 10 hours per week



I want someone who looks at this opportunity and sees more than $5 an hour.



You know how to find the right people, get their attention, build a relationship and create a genuine sales opportunity. You take ownership of your work and want your earnings to reflect the results you produce.



If you help me make serious money, I want you to make serious money too.



ABOUT VINALL BUILT DIFFERENT



I’m Stuart Vinall, founder of a premium private coaching business in Dubai.



I work primarily with successful men aged 40–60 who want to improve their strength, fitness, body composition, energy and physical confidence.



My clients include business owners, founders and senior professionals with demanding careers.



I spent 30 years in senior leadership at global companies and have trained daily for 43 years. I understand their pressures and the standards they expect.



You will be starting conversations from my Instagram account, so I need to trust your judgement and how you represent me.



PAY AND BONUSES



The base rate is $5 USD/hour for approximately 10 hours per week.



All bonuses below are in USD:



• $15 for each genuinely qualified consultation you originate that attends.

• $200 for your first prospect who becomes a paying client in a calendar month.

• $300 for your second paying-client signup that month.

• $400 each for your third and subsequent paying-client signups that month.

• An additional $100 when a client you originate renews after the initial 90 days.



Three paying-client signups in a month would earn you $900 in signup bonuses, plus your hourly pay, attended-consultation bonuses and any eligible renewal bonuses.



I also want to build rewards at 3, 6 and 12 months for consistent results, client origination, quality and contribution to the business.



If this develops as I believe it can, the 12-month reward may include a trip to Dubai to experience the business, market and brand in person.



The base gives you security. The bonuses give you the opportunity to earn substantially more.



I want someone hungry for results who protects the quality of our prospects and the reputation of the business.



HOW I EXPECT YOU TO WORK



Read the person’s profile properly.



Look at what he has written, what he is building, an opinion he has shared or something he has achieved. Find a specific reason to start a conversation with him.



If your usual opener is:



“Hey mate, I see you work in property. You must be busy. How do you find time for fitness?”



This role is unlikely to suit you.



I want to see that you have taken an interest in the individual. Ask something worth answering. Listen to his reply and develop the conversation naturally.



You need to judge when it is appropriate to discuss coaching and when to leave the conversation alone.



WHO YOU WILL LOOK FOR



Primarily Dubai/UAE-based men aged approximately 40–60:



• CEOs, founders and business owners

• Managing Directors, partners and senior executives

• Finance, investment and property professionals

• Other established professionals who could be suitable for premium private coaching



Check their location and professional background. An expensive car or holiday does not tell you whether someone is a suitable prospect.



As the conversation develops, establish whether he has a relevant need, genuine interest and the readiness to consider coaching.



Before handing him over to me, you should be able to explain why this is a worthwhile opportunity.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



• Find and verify suitable prospects.

• Research each person before contacting him.

• Write individual opening messages.

• Manage conversations in my voice.

• Follow up thoughtfully.

• Understand the prospect’s goals, obstacles and interest.

• Qualify opportunities and hand them to me with clear context.

• Keep accurate records of your work and results.



I take over qualified opportunities and close the coaching sale.



There is no initial quota of 20–30 new prospects a day. We will agree realistic expectations during the trial, allowing time for proper research and existing conversations.



I will assess the quality of your research, messages, qualification and follow-up, along with consultations attended, paying clients acquired and renewals.



EXPERIENCE AND PERSONAL QUALITIES



You should have experience in personalised outreach, relationship selling or appointment setting. Experience with premium coaching, high-ticket services or personal brands would be useful.



I’m looking for someone who:



• Writes excellent English.

• Can hold an intelligent conversation with an established professional.

• Researches carefully and checks facts.

• Understands sales qualification.

• Follows up without becoming pushy.

• Communicates reliably.

• Takes responsibility for results.

• Learns quickly and responds well to feedback.

• Wants to grow with the business.



Your messages should sound like a person having a conversation. Avoid generic compliments, forced familiarity and claims about my clients or programme that I have not given you.



APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS



Do not use ChatGPT or another AI tool to write your application, research explanations or messages.



Do not submit scraped lists, scripts or invented conversations.



I need to see how you think, research and communicate yourself.



Apply through this platform. Please do not contact me on Instagram, LinkedIn or other social channels about the job.



Your application must begin with:



BUILT DIFFERENT



Complete all four sections below.



PART 1: YOUR EXPERIENCE



In no more than 200 words, tell me:



Where you are based.



Your relevant outreach and sales experience.



The offers and customers you have represented.



The results you personally contributed to and the period covered. Include qualified consultations, attendance, paying clients or revenue where known.



Your current client commitments and total weekly working hours.



Why this role and its bonus structure interest you.



Be clear about your contribution to team results. If you do not know the conversion or revenue figures, say so.



PART 2: THREE REAL PROSPECTS



Find three real Instagram profiles you believe could be suitable prospects for VINALL BUILT DIFFERENT.



For each person, provide:



• Instagram handle and profile link

• Name

• Approximate age and how you estimated it

• Occupation and company, where verifiable

• Evidence that he currently lives or works in Dubai/UAE

• Why you selected him, making clear what you know and what you are assuming

• A specific post, statement, achievement or interest you would use to start a conversation

• A link or relevant screenshot supporting that observation

• The exact first DM you would send from my account



Avoid celebrities and obvious high-profile names. Find people you could realistically engage.



Do not contact them. This is a research exercise, and I will check your selections.



PART 3: THREE REAL CONVERSATIONS



Provide three anonymised outreach conversations you personally handled.



Each example should show:



• Your opening

• The prospect’s replies

• How you developed the conversation

• Your qualification and follow-up decisions

• The outcome



Briefly explain your contribution and any commercial result you know.



You can include an example where you d
 someone was unsuitable, provided you explain why.



Remove identifying and confidential information. Only share work you are authorised to share.



If confidentiality prevents you from providing three examples, explain this. We can consider a live exercise instead.



PART 4: FINAL DETAILS



Hourly rate:

Available working hours Monday–Friday:

Timezone:

Current weekly hours for other clients:

Earliest start date:

Relevant outreach experience:

Fitness/coaching or high-ticket experience:

Portfolio or relevant work links:



HOURS AND NEXT STEPS



The role is approximately two hours per day, Monday–Friday. We will agree working hours with suitable Dubai-time coverage.



Shortlisted applicants will have a video interview and live conversation exercise. We will discuss your research, previous results and how you would handle real conversations.



The successful applicant will start a 30-day paid trial. We will agree bonus qualification, attribution and payment terms before work begins.



I’m looking for someone I can trust with this part of my business for the long term.



Bring me the right opportunities, help me grow the business and I will reward your contribution properly.



Stuart Vinall

Founder, VINALL BUILT DIFFERENT

Dubai, UAE

title: Founding US Expat Tax Preparers (CPA / EA Preferred): Independent Contractor | Remote |
description:
We are building a modern, technology-enabled firm focused exclusively on American taxpayers living abroad.



We are looking for a founding team of experienced US Expat Tax Preparers now.



We are building structured systems, clear workflows, and long-term professional relationships from day one.



About the Firm



We serve one niche only:



US citizens and green card holders living overseas.



Our focus is precision, organization, and clean digital workflows, not high-volume domestic 1040 preparation.



We are building:



Structured digital intake systems



Clear documentation standards



Organized workflow processes



A technology-enabled environment that reduces chaos



We are recruiting early so we are fully prepared when client volume begins.



We are building an AI-Native cloud accounting firm that is technology first. 



Required Experience



You must have direct experience preparing US expat tax returns, including:



Form 1116 (Foreign Tax Credit)



Form 2555 (Foreign Earned Income Exclusion)



FinCEN 114 (FBAR)



Form 8938



Form 5471 (strongly preferred)



Form 3520



Form 8621 (PFIC experience preferred)

Strong written and spoken English

Highly organized and deadline-driven

Compensation:



Hourly: $8–$20/hour depending on experience and complexity level

Opportunity to scale hours as client volume increases

There are no fixed quotas.

You take on work you can responsibly handle.



We also operate a separate bookkeeping firm serving small businesses.



For those interested, this may provide:



Off-season income opportunities



Ongoing advisory support



More consistent year-round engagement



Participation is optional.



What We Value



We are looking for professionals who:



Take ownership of their work



Communicate clearly and proactively



Respect deadlines



Care about accuracy



See technology as a tool to improve efficiency



This is a long-term professional relationship, not short-term seasonal hiring.



Timeline



We are currently:



Interviewing and vetting candidates



Finalizing systems and workflows



Preparing for launch later this year



Selected candidates will be onboarded prior to launch.



To Apply



Please submit:



Resume



Summary of your expat tax experience



Approximate number of expat returns prepared annually



Your availability during peak filing season



Your expected hourly rate
