title: Tax Manager
description:
Role Overview

The Tax Manager will lead ProfitGrid’s finance function and serve as a strategic business partner to the CEO and leadership team. This role will be responsible for the company’s financial strategy, planning and analysis, accounting and reporting, cash management, financial controls, compliance, and overall financial health.

The ideal candidate is a commercially minded finance leader who can balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution, build scalable finance processes, and provide data-driven insights that support ProfitGrid’s growth and profitability.



Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field.

CPA or equivalent professional qualification is preferred.

10+ years of progressive experience in finance, with significant experience in a senior finance leadership role.

Strong experience in FP&A, financial planning, accounting, reporting, budgeting, and cash management.

Experience partnering with senior leadership and supporting strategic business decisions.

Strong financial modeling and analytical skills.

Excellent understanding of financial controls, compliance, and risk management.

Experience building or scaling finance processes and teams.

Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.

High level of integrity, attention to detail, and commercial acumen.

Experience in a technology, fintech, SaaS, or high-growth environment is an advantage.



Key Responsibilities:

1. Financial Strategy & Business Partnering

Develop and execute ProfitGrid’s overall financial strategy aligned with business objectives.

Partner closely with the CEO and leadership team on strategic and financial decisions.

Provide financial insights, analysis, and recommendations to support business growth and profitability.

Evaluate new business initiatives, investments, and strategic opportunities from a financial perspective.

Establish and monitor financial KPIs to measure business performance.



2. FP&A, Budgeting & Forecasting

Lead the annual budgeting and financial planning process.

Develop rolling forecasts and financial models to support business planning.

Monitor actual performance against budget and forecast and identify key variances.

Provide regular management reporting and insights on revenue, costs, margins, and profitability.

Develop scenario analyses to support strategic decision-making.



3. Accounting & Financial Reporting

Oversee the company’s accounting and financial reporting functions.

Ensure timely and accurate monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting.

Maintain appropriate accounting policies, processes, and controls.

Work closely with external accountants, auditors, tax advisors, and other financial partners.

Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards and regulatory requirements.



4. Cash Management & Treasury

Oversee cash flow management and liquidity planning.

Monitor working capital and optimize cash utilization.

Develop cash flow forecasts and ensure adequate funding for business operations.

Manage banking relationships and other financial institutions.

Establish appropriate controls around company expenditures and payments.



5. Financial Controls, Risk & Compliance

Establish and strengthen financial policies, processes, and internal controls.

Identify and mitigate financial and operational risks.

Ensure compliance with applicable Philippine tax, statutory, and regulatory requirements.

Support internal and external audits.

Maintain strong governance over financial transactions and company resources.



6. Cost Management & Profitability

Monitor operating expenses and identify opportunities for cost optimization.

Analyze business unit and company-level profitability.

Partner with department heads to improve financial accountability.

Develop frameworks for evaluating the financial impact of business decisions.

Drive initiatives that improve margins and overall financial efficiency.



7. Finance Systems & Process Transformation

Build scalable finance processes and systems that can support ProfitGrid’s growth.

Identify opportunities to automate and streamline finance operations.

Improve the quality, accessibility, and reliability of financial data.

Leverage technology and automation to increase finance efficiency and accuracy.



8. Team Leadership

Build, lead, and develop a high-performing finance team.

Establish clear roles, responsibilities, KPIs, and performance expectations.

Develop the team’s technical and commercial finance capabilities.

Foster a culture of accountability, accuracy, continuous improvement, and business partnership

title: Staff Software Engineer (L5)
description:
At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.



Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

.



Hiring and how we work



We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions! 



Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings. 

.



See yourself at Twilio



Join the team as Staff Backend Engineer on Twilio’s Flex Engineering.



About the job



As a Staff Backend Engineer on the Twilio Flex Engineering team, you will set technical direction for the systems that power TaskRouter, the real time engine that d
 how every contact center interaction reaches the right person. You will operate as the senior technical leader across multiple services, owning the architecture for problems that span multiple quarters and organizational boundaries, and you will be accountable for how the platform scales, performs, and stays available as customer demand grows. You will author and defend the designs that go to Twilio's architecture review boards, make tradeoff decisions that carry long term consequences, and raise the engineering bar across a team distributed across the world. Additionally, you will have significant influence on roadmap priorities and on how Flex delivers against Twilio's goal of being the world's most trusted customer engagement platform.



If you thrive in fast-moving environments, enjoy working on scalable systems, and are passionate about building high-performance backend services, this role is for you.



Responsibilities



In this role, you’ll:



Design, develop, and maintain backend services that power Twilio Flex’s high scale TaskRouter system.

Set and own the technical direction for a set of high scale, business critical backend services running on AWS, and hold the architectural vision as it evolves

Lead the design of large distributed systems changes, covering scalability, data architecture, fault isolation, and migration strategy

Raise availability and resilience for Tier 0 systems, and make deliberate tradeoffs between reliability, cost, and delivery speed

Partner with peer engineering teams, platform teams, and product to align on designs and unblock shared dependencies

Raise the engineering bar through design review, code review, and direct mentorship of senior and mid level engineers

Drive operational excellence through observability, gamedays, i
 response, and converting recurring issues into permanent fixes

Influence roadmap priorities with engineering and product leadership, and represent the team's technical position across the wider organization

Qualifications 



Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!



*Required:



8+ years of experience writing production-grade backend code in a modern programming language (e.g., Java, Golang, Python, Scala, or similar).

Strong fundamentals and experience in building fault tolerant distributed systems, event-driven architectures, and database design.

Experience working with AWS cloud-based infrastructure.

Well-versed in designing and building high-scale, low-latency APIs.

Experience with database technologies like MySQL, PostgreSQL or DynamoDB.

Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills for complex distributed applications.

Experience shipping services (products) following the CI/CD development paradigm.

Effective communication skills and ability to collaborate in a fast-paced team environment.

Comfortable with ambiguity and problem-solving in a rapidly growing company.

Desired:



Experience working with event streaming technologies (Kafka, Pulsar, or similar).

Familiarity with containerization and orchestration tools (Docker, Kubernetes).

Solid grasp of Linux systems and networking concepts.

Background in building multi-tenant SaaS platforms at scale.

Experience working with observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Datadog.

Experience working in a geographically distributed team.

Location



This role will be remote, and based in India - Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Telangana State, Maharashtra and New Delhi.



Travel 



We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.



What We Offer



Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.



Twilio thinks big. Do you?



We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.



So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.



.



Stay alert to recruitment fraud



We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings,
s, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an 
 address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.



.



Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

title: AEO & Social Media Strategist
description:
The role

We are hiring an AEO and Social Media Strategist to make Scouter the answer people find when they ask how to protect hiring from AI-driven cheating.



You will own how Scouter appears in answer engines such as ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews, and on social, especially LinkedIn. Your goal is to turn that visibility into inbound interest from investment firms and recruiting partners. You will work closely with the founding team, and your results will be measured in visibility, qualified conversations, and pipeline.



What you'll do

Answer engine optimization (AEO)

• Audit how AI engines describe Scouter and its category today, and track whether Scouter is cited for the queries that matter.

• Build a query map of what investment firms, recruiters, and candidates ask AI engines about assessment integrity and AI cheating in hiring.

• Create content designed to be cited: clear explainers, FAQs, comparison pages, and data-backed posts, with structured data and consistent definitions of what Scouter is.

• Earn the third-party mentions that answer engines trust, including press, industry coverage, directories, and partner and recruiting-firm pages.

• Report monthly on AI visibility and citations, and adjust the plan based on what moves them.



Social media strategy

• Own Scouter's LinkedIn presence and editorial calendar, and shape the founder's thought-leadership voice.

• Turn product insights and trends into posts, carousels, and short video, using only anonymized and approved data. Client and candidate information is never shared.

• Engage the private equity, recruiting, and HR-tech communities, and amplify launches, partnerships, and press wins.

• Test formats and topics, and tie social performance to qualified inbound conversations.

Across both

• Align messaging with sales and the founders so what people read matches what we say in conversations.

• Support PR by identifying journalists and publications that cover AI and hiring, and by drafting pitches.

What you'll bring

• Experience in content, SEO, growth, or social strategy, ideally in B2B or at an early-stage startup.

• A working understanding of AEO, also called generative engine optimization: how AI engines retrieve and cite sources, and how to test and track that.

• Strong writing that sounds credible to a finance and professional audience.

• A record of growing a LinkedIn or B2B social presence, with results you can point to.

• Comfort with analytics and tools, such as Google Analytics, Search Console, AI-visibility trackers, and social analytics.

• Ownership and speed: you set priorities, ship often, and learn from what the data shows.

Nice to have

• Experience marketing to financial services, private equity, or recruiting and HR-tech buyers.

• Technical SEO skills, including schema markup and structured data.

• Short-form video and basic design skills, in tools such as Canva or Figma.

• Familiarity with hiring, assessments, or trust and safety.

Details and how to apply



To apply, send your resume and one example of AI-search or social work you're proud of, with the results it drove.

title: Illustrator / Character Designer
description:
Illustrator Wanted – Monster Character Design for New Food Brand



Project: Mini Monster (Working Name)

Industry: Food & Beverage / Mini Dutch Pancakes

Deadline: Urgent – October 2026



We're looking for a talented and creative character illustrator / mascot designer to help bring an exciting new food brand to life!



We're launching a brand dedicated to mini Dutch pancakes, currently working under the name Mini Monster.



Our vision is to create a fun, bold, colourful and instantly recognisable brand built around a family of unique monster characters.



The Concept



We want to create a collection of adorable, quirky and mischievous monsters, each representing a different mini pancake flavour.



For example:



Biscoff Monster – Inspired by Biscoff biscuits and caramel tones.



Strawberry Monster – A playful pink or red strawberry-inspired character.



The OG Monster – Our original signature monster.



Nutella Monster – A chocolate-inspired character.



Cookies & Cream Monster – A fun cookies-and-cream-inspired character.



These are examples only, and we're open to creative ideas!



Each monster should have its own unique personality, expression and characteristics, while still looking like part of the same family.



Illustration Style



We're looking for characters that are:



Cute, quirky, cheeky and full of personality.



Bold, colourful and visually striking.



Modern and playful, but not overly childish.



Memorable and instantly recognisable.



Suitable for both children and adults.



Designed with clean shapes and strong outlines that reproduce well across different sizes.



We particularly love bright green and pink, but we're open to a wider colour palette for the individual monsters.



We'll provide AI-generated concept images as visual references to communicate the direction we're exploring. However, we want original, professionally illustrated characters, not copies of the AI concepts.



Where the Characters Will Be Used



The illustrations will become a major part of our brand identity and feature across:



Marquee and event stall signage



Menu boards



Pancake packaging, cups and boxes



Stickers and merchandise



Social media and marketing campaigns



Website and promotional material



It's important that the characters work individually and together as a recognisable collection.



Project Deliverables



We're looking for an illustrator who can help with:



Developing our main signature Mini Monster mascot.



Creating a consistent character style for the brand.



Designing additional flavour-inspired monster characters.



Providing character variations or expressions where appropriate.



Supplying final artwork in editable vector formats (AI, EPS or SVG), along with transparent PNG files.



We'd also like full commercial usage rights for the final approved illustrations, including permission to use and adapt them across packaging, signage, merchandise and future marketing.



Timeline – Urgent

title: B2B Appointment Setter / Cold Caller
description:
B2B Appointment Setter / Cold Caller - $500 USD + Uncapped Performance Bonuses

Velo Systems

Full-Time | Remote | 9 AM - 5 PM Eastern Time

$500 USD/month base + uncapped performance bonuses



ABOUT VELO SYSTEMS

Velo Systems helps established med spas improve how they handle inbound calls and booking opportunities using AI-powered receptionist technology.



We are currently building our outbound sales team and are looking for an experienced B2B appointment setter who is confident speaking with business owners and decision-makers.



This is a sales position, not a basic virtual assistant or data-entry role.



You will be responsible for starting conversations with med spa owners, identifying potential problems around missed or unanswered calls, handling objections, and booking qualified appointments for our closer.



You will not be responsible for closing the final sale.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

Your main responsibility is to generate qualified sales appointments through outbound calling.



You will:

• Make outbound cold calls to med spas

• Speak with business owners and decision-makers

• Navigate receptionists and gatekeepers

• Identify potential pain around missed or unanswered calls

• Create interest in Velo Systems

• Handle common objections

• Lightly qualify prospects

• Book qualified appointments

• Follow up with interested prospects

• Confirm appointments

• Keep the CRM updated

• Maintain consistent daily activity



The sales process is simple:

Cold call → Conversation → Light qualification → Appointment → Closer



Our closer handles the deeper discovery, demonstration, pricing, objections, and closing.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Required

• 2+ years of proven B2B cold calling or appointment-setting experience

• Strong spoken English

• Confident and professional phone presence

• Experience speaking with business owners or decision-makers

• Strong objection-handling ability

• Ability to have natural conversations instead of simply reading a script

• Strong follow-up habits

• Reliable internet connection

• Quiet workspace

• Ability to consistently work 9 AM - 5 PM Eastern Time



Experience selling marketing services, SaaS, AI, agency services, healthcare, med spa services, or other B2B services is a strong advantage.



We care more about what you have actually produced than how impressive your resume sounds.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You should be comfortable hearing:

• "Not interested."

• "Just send me an
."

• "We already have a receptionist."

• "How much does it cost?"

• "I'm too busy."

• "Call me later."



You should be able to stay calm, think on your feet, and keep the conversation moving without becoming overly aggressive or pushy.



You should also know when a prospect is not a good fit.



We care about qualified appointments, not simply filling the calendar.



DAILY ACTIVITY

Our initial target is approximately:

100 to 150 outbound attempts per day



This is not a competition to make meaningless calls.



We care about the entire funnel:

Calls → Conversations → Decision-makers → Qualified prospects → Appointments → Shows → Clients



A setter who makes 150 poor calls is not more valuable than someone who makes 100 high-quality calls and consistently produces qualified opportunities.



COMPENSATION

$500 USD/month base



Plus:

• Uncapped performance bonuses



Performance bonuses are tied to qualified appointments that attend and clients generated from your appointments.



There is no ceiling on performance earnings.



The exact bonus structure will be explained during the interview.



Our goal is to reward people who actually produce results.



TRAINING

You will not simply receive a phone number and be told to start dialing.



Before working with live leads, you will receive training on:

• Velo Systems

• Our AI receptionist solution

• Our target market

• Cold-call structure

• Receptionist and gatekeeper handling

• Qualification

• Objection handling

• Appointment booking

• Calendly

• CRM usage

• Follow-up

• Appointment confirmation



You will also complete roleplay before beginning live outbound.



HOW WE MEASURE PERFORMANCE

We track the entire sales funnel:

Outbound Attempts

↓

Connections

↓

Decision-Maker Conversations

↓

Qualified Prospects

↓

Appointments Booked

↓

Appointments Showed

↓

Closed Clients



We use these numbers to identify where the sales process can be improved.



You will also receive coaching based on actual recorded calls.



LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY

We are looking for someone who wants to build a long-term position with the company.



As the sales operation grows, there will be opportunities for increased earning potential and additional responsibility for strong performers.



APPLICATION PROCESS

Please answer every question below.



Incomplete applications will not be considered.



1. How many years of B2B cold-calling experience do you have?

2. How many years of appointment-setting experience do you have?

3. What industries or types of businesses have you previously called?

4. Were your leads primarily cold, warm, inbound, or a mixture?

Please explain.

5. Approximately how many outbound calls did you make per day in your previous role?

6. Approximately how many qualified appointments did you generate per week or month?

7. What was your approximate appointment show rate?

If you don't know, just say so.

8. Who were you typically calling?

For example:

• Business owners

• CEOs

• Managers

• Receptionists

• Consumers

9. What countries were you calling?

10. What was the most difficult objection you regularly encountered, and how did you handle it?



ROLEPLAY QUESTION 1

Imagine you're calling a med spa owner.

They say:

"We already have a receptionist. We're not interested in an AI receptionist."

What would you say?

Write your response exactly as you would say it on the phone.



ROLEPLAY QUESTION 2

The owner says:

"Just send me an
."

What would you say?



VOICE RECORDING

Please provide a 60 to 90 second voice recording introducing yourself.



Tell us:

• Your sales experience

• Your cold-calling experience

• What type of businesses you've called

• Why you believe you'd be a strong fit for this position



We want to hear your natural speaking voice, confidence, communication style, and professionalism.



WORK SETUP

Please confirm that you have:

• Reliable computer

• Reliable high-speed internet

• Quality headset/microphone

• Quiet workspace

• Ability to work 9 AM - 5 PM Eastern Time



ATTENTION TO DETAIL

At the very end of your application, include:

VELO SALES



This lets us know that you read the entire job post.

title: Part-Time Graphic Designer — Print & Brand (Brochures, Banners, Large Format)
description:
We are three UK businesses run by the same owner. We are looking for ONE part-time graphic designer to handle print and brand work across all of them.



10 hours per week. 400 USD per month. Long-term, not a one-off project.



That works out at roughly 9 USD per hour, which we know is above the usual part-time rate here. That is deliberate. We would rather pay properly for fewer hours of someone genuinely good than fill more hours with work we could have produced ourselves. In a busy month there is scope for more hours at the same hourly rate.



ABOUT US



Tuition Republic is a weekend tuition centre in Walthamstow, east London. We teach English, Maths and Science to children aged 5 to 16, on Saturdays and Sundays. Website: 



Pure Oud is a fragrance brand selling oud and attar perfumes. Website: 
. It is a completely different register from the tuition centre: warmer, quieter, more premium. The A5 brochure that goes inside every customer order has to feel like it belongs with the product.



The third business is a second tuition centre, which shares Tuition Republic's visual language.



Please look at both websites before applying. Being able to move between those two worlds, a friendly and trustworthy children's education brand and a premium fragrance brand, is the main thing we are looking for.



WHAT THIS ROLE ACTUALLY IS



We are not asking you to invent brands from scratch. All three businesses already have logos, colour palettes and photography. We also produce our own first drafts, often with AI tools, and they get us to about 80 percent.



We are hiring you for the other 20 percent: typography, spacing, hierarchy, and knowing how a file behaves when it is actually printed. If your plan is to run our brief through an AI image tool and send back what it gives you, please do not apply. We can already do that ourselves and it is exactly the thing that is not good enough.



WHAT YOU WILL BE GIVEN



- Logo files and a settled brand palette for each business. Tuition Republic's is cyan, navy and white, with a single orange reserved for the main call to action. The palettes are d
 and are not part of this job. We will give you the exact colour values and we expect the work to stay inside them.

- Professional photography, high resolution.

- Our own draft layouts for most pieces, as a starting point.

- A written brief for every job, with references.



THE WORK WAITING FOR YOU



1. A roller banner, 850 x 2000 mm, that stands outside a school entrance. Hundreds of parents walk past it every week. The current one does not stand out and needs redesigning. This will be your first task.

2. A 12-page A4 welcome pack for the tuition centre. Exists, needs refining to a proper standard.

3. The A5 brochure for Pure Oud. This one has to be immaculate.

4. A brochure for the second tuition centre.

5. Possibly an 11+ exam preparation starter pack.



After that: ongoing leaflets, posters, social graphics and seasonal campaign artwork, a few pieces most weeks.



WHAT YOU MUST BE ABLE TO DO



- Set multi-page documents properly. InDesign preferred, Illustrator acceptable.

- Produce genuinely print-ready files: CMYK, correct bleed and safe margins, correct resolution, fonts packaged or outlined, imposition where needed.

- Design for large format, where the reader is 10 metres away and moving.

- Work to a fixed brand palette without drifting off it.

- Take written feedback and revise without needing to be re-briefed from the beginning.



Social media graphics are a small part of this role, not the main part. If your portfolio is only Canva social tiles, this is not the right fit and we will be able to tell.



NO UNPAID TEST TASK



We are not going to ask you to design our banner for free so we can pick a favourite. We know spec work is common here and we think it is unfair on good designers, who have other clients and cannot afford to work for nothing.



If we shortlist you and we want to see how you work before committing, we will pay you for that piece of work at a rate we agree first. Nothing you produce for us is unpaid.



HOW WE WORK



- English written communication. We brief in writing, in detail, with references.

- Flexible hours. We do not monitor your screen. We care about the work landing on time.

- Paid monthly. We are reliable and we expect the same.



TO APPLY, SEND US THREE THINGS



1. Two or three examples of PRINT work you took from rough to press-ready. Brochures, banners, signage, packaging. Tell us which part was your own work.

2. One of those examples with a sentence on what the printer sent back or what you had to fix. We want to know you have dealt with real print production, not just exported a PDF.

3. A banner outside a school is read by a parent 10 metres away, walking, in about two seconds. In two or three sentences: what is the single most important decision in designing that?



Applications that skip point 3 will not be read. We are reading every one that includes it.
salary: $400 USD per month (10 hours per week)

title: PART TIME GOOGLE AND META ADS SPECIALIST - E-COMMERCE BRAND
description:
Anamchara Cords | Remote | Part-time



I'm looking for an experienced Google Ads + Meta Ads specialist to help manage and improve the paid advertising for my growing Irish e-commerce brand, Anamchara Cords.



Anamchara creates handmade, bespoke Celtic handfasting cords for weddings and commitment ceremonies. We sell internationally, with customers primarily in Ireland, the UK, USA, Canada, Europe and Australia.



This is a small but established e-commerce business, and I'm looking for someone who can take a proper look at our existing advertising, identify what's working and what's not, and then make intelligent, commercially focused improvements.



What you'll be responsible for:



Google Ads



* Google Search campaigns

* Google Shopping

* Keyword and search-term analysis

* Negative keyword management

* Ad copy testing

* Bid and budget optimisation

* Conversion tracking

* Google Merchant Centre

* Identifying opportunities to improve ROAS and reduce wasted spend



Meta Ads



*
 and Instagram advertising

* Catalogue/product ads

* Retargeting

* Prospecting

* Audience analysis

* Creative and copy testing

* Budget optimisation

* Monitoring ROAS, CPA, CTR, CPC and conversion performance



Your first priority



I don't want someone to simply "check the ads" and send me a weekly report.



Initially, I want you to audit our existing Google and Meta advertising and give me a clear understanding of:



* What is working?

* What isn't working?

* Where are we potentially wasting money?

* Are our campaigns structured correctly?

* Is conversion tracking working properly?

* Are we targeting the right customers?

* What would you change first?

* Where are the biggest opportunities for improvement?



From there, you'll be responsible for implementing and testing improvements and monitoring the results.



I want someone who understands why people buy, understands e-commerce data and can make sensible decisions based on the numbers.



About you



You should have:



* At least 2 years' hands-on experience with Google Ads

* At least 2 years' hands-on experience with Meta Ads

* Proven e-commerce experience

* Experience with Google Search and Shopping

* Experience with Meta sales/catalogue campaigns

* Experience with GA4 and conversion tracking

* Strong analytical skills

* Excellent written and spoken English

* The ability to explain your recommendations clearly to a non-technical business owner



E-commerce experience with Etsy, Shopify, handmade products, weddings, fashion, jewellery, gifts or lifestyle brands would be a big advantage.



Hours & pay



5 hours per week to start



$5–$8 USD per hour, depending on experience.



I'm happy to increase the hours and rate for the right person as the business grows and we establish a good working relationship.



I'm looking for someone who wants to work with the business long-term rather than someone who is simply looking for another short-term VA client.



IMPORTANT – please include this in your application



I don't want a generic application.



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. How many years you have personally managed Google Ads

3. How many years you have personally managed Meta Ads

4. Two examples of e-commerce businesses you have worked with

5. The approximate monthly ad spend you managed for them

6. What results you achieved

7. Which Google and Meta campaign types you are most experienced with

8. Your hourly rate

9. Your availability



Please also answer this question:



Imagine you have taken over an e-commerce advertising account where sales have recently slowed.



What are the first 5 things you would investigate before changing the campaigns?



Please explain your reasoning rather than simply listing five things.



Applications that clearly demonstrate your thinking will be prioritised.



Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a short paid audit/trial task before being given access to the live advertising accounts.

s, documents and multiple requests.

title: Senior Luxury Cruise & Air Travel Consultant
description:
Savvy Travel Limited is a New Zealand-based travel business operating across two complementary areas:



Wholesale Cruise Distribution: An established cruise wholesale and representation business working closely with retail travel agents, travel agency groups and international cruise suppliers. We support our travel trade partners with cruise product expertise, reservations, quotations, supplier information and the development of cruise and travel packages.



Luxury Retail Travel: A developing luxury retail travel agency specialising in premium and luxury cruises, international Business Class and Premium Economy airfares, and tailor-made travel experiences incorporating luxury accommodation, rail journeys, private touring and other specialist travel arrangements.



We are seeking an experienced travel professional who can support both businesses and contribute to the growth of our luxury retail offering.



This is a senior, hands-on role requiring advanced Amadeus expertise, extensive knowledge of international and wholesale airfares, strong luxury cruise product knowledge and exceptional customer service skills.



Key Responsibilities



1. Wholesale Cruise – Travel Agent Support



Work directly with retail travel agents, travel agency groups and trade partners.

Respond to cruise enquiries, prepare quotations and manage reservations on behalf of retail travel agents.

Provide knowledgeable advice on premium, luxury and expedition cruise products.

Support agents with cruise itineraries, cabin categories, inclusions, promotions, booking conditions and supplier requirements.

Develop cruise packages incorporating international airfares, rail, accommodation, transfers and land tours.

Liaise directly with international cruise lines and supplier reservations teams.

Manage booking amendments, payments, documentation and pre-departure requirements.

Build trusted, professional relationships with retail travel agents through responsive, accurate and proactive service.

Support trade marketing campaigns, cruise promotions and supplier initiatives.

Understand wholesale distribution, trade commissions, pricing structures and the importance of protecting travel agent relationships.



2. Luxury Retail Travel – Premium Customer Consulting



Support the development and growth of a startup luxury retail travel agency.

Work directly with premium and high-value customers to design exceptional international travel experiences.

Specialise in five-star and luxury cruises, Business Class and Premium Economy airfares, luxury accommodation and bespoke travel arrangements.

Develop personalised travel itineraries incorporating cruises, rail, private tours, transfers and unique travel experiences.

Provide knowledgeable destination and product recommendations tailored to individual customer preferences.

Manage the customer journey from initial enquiry and quotation through to booking, documentation and post-travel follow-up.

Deliver highly personalised, professional and proactive customer service.

Contribute to the development of customer service processes, booking procedures and operational systems for the new retail business.

Identify opportunities to build long-term customer relationships, repeat business and referrals.



3. International Airfares & Amadeus



Demonstrate advanced, hands-on proficiency in Amadeus GDS.

Research, construct, quote and book complex international air itineraries.

Understand cruise-related airfares, cruise line air programmes and air arrangements associated with international cruise departures.

Apply strong knowledge of airline alliances, routing rules, fare construction, ticketing conditions and premium cabin products.

Manage ticketing, exchanges, reissues, refunds, schedule changes and travel disruptions.

Identify competitive airfare solutions while maintaining appropriate margins and exceptional customer service.



4. Luxury Cruise Product & Reservations



Maintain extensive knowledge of premium, luxury and expedition cruise products.

Research, quote and manage cruise reservations across multiple international cruise lines.

Understand cruise line positioning, ship experiences, destinations, cabin categories, inclusions and promotional offers.

Provide expert recommendations to both retail travel agents and direct customers.

Coordinate cruise bookings with international flights, accommodation and other travel components.

Manage supplier communications, booking deadlines, documentation and changes.

Experience with cruise brands such as Windstar, Holland America Line, Seabourn, Regent Seven Seas, Oceania, Silversea, Ponant, Azamara, Explora Journeys, Viking and other premium cruise operators will be highly regarded.



5. Tailor-Made Travel, Rail & Land Tours



Design complex international itineraries combining cruises, flights, rail, accommodation and land tours.

Research and arrange premium accommodation, private transfers, independent touring and small-group experiences.

Develop pre- and post-cruise travel packages.

Coordinate multiple suppliers to ensure seamless travel arrangements.

Prepare professional, accurate and detailed itineraries and travel documentation.



6. Commercial & Operational Management



Prepare accurate quotations and booking costings.

Understand wholesale and retail pricing, supplier commissions, agency margins and markups.

Maintain accurate booking records, customer information and supplier documentation.

Manage booking deadlines, deposits, final payments and supplier requirements.

Support the development of efficient systems and processes across both businesses.

Contribute ideas to improve customer experience, operational efficiency and commercial performance.

Work independently while collaborating with the New Zealand-based team.



7. Technology & AI



Demonstrate advanced Amadeus capability and proficiency with relevant cruise supplier booking systems.

Use digital tools and AI to support destination research, itinerary planning, documentation and productivity.

Verify all booking-critical information, including fares, availability, travel requirements and supplier conditions, through authoritative sources.

Maintain strong standards of accuracy, confidentiality and data security.

Identify opportunities to improve booking workflows and operational efficiency through technology.



Essential Experience & Skills



Minimum 7 years' experience in international travel consulting, airfare reservations, cruise sales or wholesale travel operations.

Advanced Amadeus GDS experience is essential.

Strong experience with international wholesale, consolidator and negotiated airfares.

Extensive knowledge of Business Class and Premium Economy international travel.

Experience with premium and luxury cruise products and reservations.

Demonstrated ability to construct and manage complex international itineraries.

Experience working with travel agents, wholesale travel businesses or travel trade distribution.

Excellent written and spoken English.

Exceptional attention to detail, organisation and customer service.

Strong commercial awareness and the ability to work independently.

Confidence communicating with both professional travel agents and premium retail customers.

Experience with cruise wholesalers, cruise lines or specialist cruise travel agencies.

Established knowledge of luxury and expedition cruise products.

Experience supporting a startup travel agency or developing new travel business processes.

Experience with cruise supplier portals, CRM systems and travel booking technology.



The successful candidate will be:

Highly experienced, knowledgeable and passionate about travel.

Professional, polished and confident communicating with retail travel agents and discerning customers.

Commercially minded, proactive and solutions-focused.

Meticulous, organised and committed to accuracy.

Comfortable working in both an established wholesale business and an emerging luxury retail agency.

Entrepreneurial, adaptable and willing to help build a new business.

Self-motivated and capable of independently managing complex travel arrangements.

Committed to delivering exceptional service and developing long-term customer and trade relationships.

title: Virtual Assistant for Renovation Operations (Estimator or Builder Background Preferred)

s, photos, videos and brief instructions into clearly organised tasks, then make sure those tasks keep moving until they’re done.

s represent Clipster directly.

title: YouTube Script Writer – Faceless Explainer Channel
description:
We are building faceless YouTube explainer channels and are looking for a strong script writer who can research topics and turn them into clear, interesting, easy-to-follow YouTube scripts.



Our videos will cover topics such as:



Engineering



Machines and technology



Science



Infrastructure



History



Interesting facts



“Every Type of ___ Explained”



“How ___ Works”



“Why ___ Happens”



Example channels to understand the style:



Byte Sized Explainer





The Paint Explainer





Bluntly Explained





AiTelly





We are looking for someone who can study successful videos in the niche and understand:



Why the topic is interesting



What questions the viewer wants answered



How to create a strong opening hook



How to keep the script moving without unnecessary filler



How to explain complicated ideas in simple language



How to keep viewers curious until the end



You may use ChatGPT and other AI tools to help with research and organization, but we do NOT want low-quality AI-generated scripts copied and submitted without editing.



Every script should be fact-checked, natural, well organized, and written for a real YouTube audience.



Typical Script Length



Approximately 1,500–2,000 words for an 8–12 minute video.



Responsibilities



Research assigned topics



Study successful competing videos before writing



Create a strong hook in the first 15–30 seconds



Write clear and entertaining scripts



Explain technical subjects simply



Find interesting facts, examples, comparisons, and statistics



Verify important factual claims



Remove filler and repetitive writing



Make revisions when necessary



Provide sources used for important facts



Pay



Starting at $5–$10 USD per approved script, depending on quality and complexity. Paid at the end of the month.



There will be consistent work for the right person.



This position will begin with a 60-day paid trial. Writers who consistently produce strong scripts may receive more work and higher pay over time.



When Applying, Please Answer:



How many years of script writing or content writing experience do you have?



Have you written scripts for faceless YouTube channels before?



Send 2–3 examples of your best YouTube scripts.



What niches have you written about?



How do you research a topic before writing?



How do you fact-check information?



How do you write a strong YouTube hook?



Have you used ChatGPT or other AI tools for research or writing?



How do you make sure an AI-assisted script still sounds natural and original?



How many 1,500–2,000 word scripts could you realistically complete each week?



Are you personally doing the work, or will you subcontract it?



IMPORTANT



We do not want someone who simply asks ChatGPT to write a script and sends us the result.



We want a writer who can use AI as a tool but still:



Research the topic



Verify facts



Improve the structure



Add interesting details



Remove filler



Create curiosity



Write naturally



We want scripts that are simple enough for anyone to understand but interesting enough to keep someone watching until the end.

title: VA for YouTube channel management (LONG TERM POSITION)
Senior Performance Video Editor (US DTC Brands)
description:
Summary

ABOUT US

We run a small studio of US direct-to-consumer brands. Video is our biggest sales driver across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, AppLovin (Axon) and our own sites. We want a senior editor who owns the creative, not someone working through a queue.



THE ROLE

Our creators send us raw footage. You turn it into ads that sell. You pick the angle, write the hooks, cut the ad and make the variations. Where footage is missing, you generate it with AI. Sometimes you'll build ads end to end. You'll see the results and help decide what we make next.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Turn UGC and creator footage into short-form ads, choosing the best moments, hooks and structure

- Write hooks, scripts and on-screen copy for US audiences from short briefs

- Work across proven ad formats: UGC testimonial, problem/solution, us vs. them, listicle, founder story, unboxing, before/after, green screen, street interview

- Create AI-generated clips, b-roll, voiceovers and visuals, and blend them naturally with real footage

- Track TikTok and Meta trends weekly and bring us ideas we should test

- Review ad performance with us and help decide what to iterate

- Keep files, assets and brand guidelines organized across brands



WHAT YOU BRING

- A portfolio of ads made for US e-commerce or DTC brands (required)

- 3+ years of professional editing, mostly short-form ads

- Expert in at least one professional editor: Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, CapCut or equivalent

- Comfortable with After Effects or another motion graphics tool for animated text, overlays and simple animation

- Hands-on experience with AI video and audio tools (Higgsfield, Arcads, ElevenLabs, Kling, Veo, Runway, HeyGen or similar)

- Natural, US-sounding English for hooks and scripts

- Range: you can make an ad that works for a 70-year-old on
 and one that works for a young parent on TikTok

- Working knowledge of Meta and TikTok ad policies, especially around health claims

- A self-starter mindset: you bring ideas, not just questions



BONUS

- Motion graphics and light animation

- Familiarity with hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CPA and ROAS

- Examples of ads you made that scaled, with numbers



DETAILS

- Full-time, remote, independent contractor, long-term

- Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM Pacific Time (currently 12 AM to 8 AM Manila time). This is a night shift and is required, so we can give feedback and iterate the same day.

- Requirements: reliable computer capable of 4K editing, backup internet and backup power

title: Social Media Manager
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a proactive and tech-savvy Social Media Manager to build, organize, manage, and automate our social media presence across multiple platforms.

This role goes beyond simply creating and posting content. The ideal candidate will be responsible for establishing a strong and consistent Rate DNA presence across social platforms, connecting our accounts and marketing tools, creating efficient workflows, and automating repetitive tasks wherever possible.

You will help build a social media system that is organized, scalable, responsive, and designed to generate engagement and qualified leads with minimal manual effort.

Platforms

The Social Media Manager will manage and/or establish Rate DNA's presence on platforms including:

-

- Instagram

- Threads

- LinkedIn

- TikTok

- X 
)

- Nextdoor

- Google Business Profile

- Alignable

- Other relevant social and business platforms as needed

Key Responsibilities

1. Social Media Account Setup & Management

- Create, claim, verify, and optimize Rate DNA profiles across all relevant platforms.

- Ensure all accounts use consistent branding, company information, contact details, logos, descriptions, and visual identity.

- Secure accounts using appropriate passwords, permissions, two-factor authentication, and administrator access.

- Maintain an organized record of account access, ownership, and platform credentials.

- Identify additional platforms and directories that may benefit Rate DNA's online presence.

2. Social Media Management & Scheduling

- Set up and maintain a centralized social media scheduling and management system using tools such as Meta Business Suite, Buffer, Hootsuite, or similar platforms.

- Build and maintain a monthly content calendar.

- Schedule content across multiple platforms while adapting posts to each platform's format and audience.

- Maintain a consistent posting schedule.

- Monitor scheduled content and troubleshoot publishing issues.

3. Content Creation

- Create engaging social media posts relevant to mortgage, real estate, home financing, interest rates, and related topics.

- Develop graphics using Canva or similar design tools.

- Create and edit short-form videos for platforms such as Instagram Reels, TikTok,
, and YouTube Shorts when applicable.

- Repurpose existing content into multiple formats and platforms.

- Develop educational, promotional, community-focused, and lead-generation content.

- Maintain consistent Rate DNA branding and messaging across all content.

4. Social Media Automation

- Identify repetitive social media and marketing tasks that can be automated.

- Build and maintain workflows for:

  - Cross-posting

  - Content scheduling

  - Automated responses

  - DM triggers

  - Lead notifications

  - Lead routing

  - CRM updates

  - Internal team notifications

- Connect social media platforms with CRM and other business systems using tools such as Zapier, Make, or similar automation platforms.

- Test automations regularly and troubleshoot failed workflows.

- Continuously look for ways to reduce manual work while maintaining quality and personalization.

5. Lead Management & Routing

- Monitor comments, direct messages, inquiries, and social media leads.

- Respond to basic inquiries promptly and professionally.

- Identify potential sales leads and route them to the appropriate team member or CRM.

- Ensure lead information is captured accurately.

- Create automated lead-routing workflows where appropriate.

- Track the source of leads generated through social media.

6. Community Management

- Monitor comments, mentions, reviews, and messages across platforms.

- Respond to customers and prospects in a professional, helpful, and timely manner.

- Escalate questions or complaints that require management or specialized assistance.

- Monitor brand mentions and relevant conversations.

- Maintain a positive and professional online presence for Rate DNA.

7. Mortgage & Real Estate Compliance

- Ensure social media content follows applicable mortgage and real estate advertising requirements.

- Follow company guidelines regarding NMLS information, Equal Housing Opportunity requirements, disclosures, licensing information, and advertising language.

- Review content for compliance before publishing.

- Work with management/compliance personnel when clarification or approval is required.

- Stay informed about company-specific marketing and compliance requirements.

8. Analytics & Reporting

- Monitor social media performance across platforms.

- Track key metrics including:

  - Engagement

  - Followers and audience growth

  - Reach and impressions

  - Website traffic

  - Leads generated

  - Messages and inquiries

  - Content performance

- Prepare a monthly social media performance report.

- Identify top-performing content and opportunities for improvement.

- Provide recommendations based on data and performance trends.

9. Continuous Improvement

- Research new social media features, tools, automation opportunities, and emerging platforms.

- Recommend new tools or workflows that can improve efficiency.

- Test new content formats and strategies.

- Continuously improve Rate DNA's social media presence and lead-generation process.

- Stay current with changes to platform algorithms, policies, and best practices.

Required Qualifications

- 2+ years of experience in social media management, digital marketing, or a related role.

- Strong experience managing multiple social media platforms.

- Experience creating social media content, graphics, and short-form videos.

- Experience with social media scheduling and management platforms.

- Strong understanding of social media marketing and audience engagement.

- Experience with automation tools such as Zapier, Make, or similar platforms.

- Experience connecting social media platforms with CRMs or other business applications.

- Strong organizational and time-management skills.

- Excellent written English and communication skills.

- Strong attention to detail.

- Ability to work independently and manage multiple platforms simultaneously.

- Ability to troubleshoot basic technical and automation issues.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience working with a mortgage, real estate, financial services, or related company.

- Knowledge of mortgage and real estate advertising compliance.

- Experience with NMLS and Equal Housing requirements.

- Experience with CRM platforms and lead-routing systems.

- Experience with Canva, CapCut, Adobe Express, or similar creative tools.

- Experience with Google Business Profile.

- Experience building automated marketing workflows.

- Basic understanding of SEO and local marketing.

- Experience managing online reviews and business listings.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who is:

- Tech-savvy and comfortable learning new platforms.

- Automation-minded and always looking for ways to eliminate repetitive manual work.

- Creative and able to produce engaging content.

- Proactive rather than waiting to be told what to do.

- Detail-oriented, especially when managing multiple accounts and automations.

- Organized and capable of maintaining a clear content calendar and workflow.

- Analytical and able to use data to improve performance.

- Reliable and responsive when managing comments, messages, and leads.

- Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance may be evaluated based on:

- Successful setup and optimization of all required social media accounts.

- Consistency and quality of social media content.

- Growth in followers and engagement.

- Increase in reach and brand visibility.

- Number and quality of leads generated.

- Response time to comments and inquiries.

- Successful implementation of automation workflows.

- Reduction in repetitive manual social media tasks.

- Accuracy of lead routing and CRM updates.

- Compliance with company and industry advertising requirements.

- Timely and accurate monthly reporting.

Working Relationship

The Social Media Manager will work closely with management, marketing, sales, and other team members to ensure that social media activity supports Rate DNA's overall marketing and lead-generation goals.

The successful candidate should be comfortable taking ownership of the social media ecosystem—from account setup and branding to content creation, automation, engagement, lead routing, analytics, and continuous optimization.

title: Guest Experience Specialist
description:
Excellent spoken English is the most important requirement for this role. Guests will hear you on the phone. We will teach you the software and our process.



Sonoma Coastal Collection is a locally rooted, family-owned property management company serving California's Sonoma Coast — Sea Ranch, Gualala, Sonoma, and the surrounding coastal communities — with over 200 curated vacation homes. Our deep connection to this region is what inspired us to build Sonoma Coastal Collection. We are focused on providing thoughtful, memorable stays for our guests and reliable, attentive stewardship for our homeowners. Our goal is to grow in a way that honors what makes the Sonoma Coast special — its dramatic coastline, redwood forests, tight-knit communities, and slower pace of life — while delivering exceptional experiences for guests and trusted, long-term partnerships for homeowners.

Tech stack (daily tools): Guesty (PMS), Breezeway (tasks/workorders + cleaning), Akia (guest messaging), Zoom Phone (calls).

Our Promises



Everything we do is guided by our Promises. They are our operating standard and the way we earn five-star stays and trusted, long-term homeowner partnerships.



Thoughtful Guest Engagement: Proactive, genuine hospitality from booking to five-star review. We believe vacations are special — something people save for, plan for, and look forward to. Our job is to make every stay feel seamless and memorable. We anticipate needs, communicate early, check in during the stay, and resolve issues quickly with warmth and care. Our guest journey is intentionally crafted to deliver the kind of responsiveness, thoughtfulness, and attention to detail that turns a great trip into an unforgettable coastal experience.



Attentive Home Stewardship: We care for every home as if it were our own. As people who live and work on this coast, we know what true home stewardship looks like. We operate with a proactive mindset of quality, consistency, and pride. Regular home checks, rigorous cleaning standards, quality control, seasonal readiness, and preventive maintenance are all part of how we ensure every property is clean, protected, and presentation-ready — for guests and for you. We treat every home with the same respect and diligence we expect for our own.



Trusted Homeowner Partnerships: We treat each home like our own investment. Every homeowner has different goals — maximizing revenue, balancing personal use, focusing on long-term appreciation, or simply enjoying peace of mind. Our role is to be a true partner in those goals, not simply a property manager. As owners and operators in this region ourselves, our guidance comes from real-world results, not theory. Through regular business reviews, thoughtful design and amenity recommendations, revenue and pricing insights, and brand-building support, we help each property reach its highest potential.

Our Guest Experience team is one of the biggest ways we deliver these promises. This is hospitality work. You are a core part of our team, not an outsourced call-center function.



Job Description: Guest Experience Specialist — Sonoma Coast

As a Guest Experience Specialist, you own guest communication and coordination. You are the voice of Sonoma Coastal Collection, a core part of our team, and a key driver of five-star stays. This role is built around answering phones and helping with guest messaging in Akia. Excellent spoken English matters more than prior software experience — we will teach you Guesty, Breezeway, Akia, and Zoom Phone, and we will teach you our process. You will also coordinate work orders and cleaning schedules with our local teams and vendors, and bring thoughtful hospitality to every stay.



You will own:

Answer guest calls and return missed calls promptly (Zoom Phone)

Guest messaging in Akia, with warmth and clarity

Proactive outreach and warm guest engagement that drives five-star stays

Work order coordination and task follow-through

Cleaning scheduling and day-to-day coordination with our local team and vendors



Working Hours

This is one fixed schedule. There is no shift rotation.

Days: Sunday, Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday

Hours: 9:00am–6:00pm Pacific Time

Days off: Friday and Saturday



Shift length: 9 hours, including up to 90 minutes of self-scheduled break time

Philippines time during Pacific Daylight Time (roughly March–November): 12:00am–9:00am PHT

Philippines time during Pacific Standard Time (roughly November–March): 1:00am–10:00am PHT

Night shift differential: +$50 USD per month, because this schedule is overnight in the Philippines



Compensation and Incentives

Base pay: $650–$750 USD per month (full-time, based on experience)

Night shift differential: +$50 per month

Internet/tech allowance: $20 per month

13th month pay: offered in December (prorated for partial years)



Monthly Bonus: Monthly 5-Star Bonus Pool (based on team review quality + individual SLA performance)

PTO: Accrues at 1 paid day per month (usable after 90 days; no annual rollover)

Monthly 5-Star Bonus Pool

We keep the bonus simple, measurable, and tied directly to delivering thoughtful guest experiences — the heart of your role.

Pool funding: $2.00 USD for every 5-star review received during the month.

Quality gate: Pool funded only if the monthly average rating is 4.85+ and the review rate is 80%+.

Distribution: The funded pool is divided equally among the Guest Experience Team members.

Eligibility: You receive your share when monthly SLA and performance standards are met. Shares are not redistributed from non-eligible members.



Location

These roles are fully remote within the Philippines.



Role and Responsibilities

Phone support (Zoom Phone)

Answer calls quickly and calmly and return missed calls promptly

Troubleshoot common issues (access codes, Wi-Fi, amenities, heating/hot tub basics, recreation passes) and escalate when needed

Thoughtful Guest Engagement (Akia + text/email)

Answer guest messages in Akia with warmth, clarity, and genuine care

Proactively share helpful guidance (arrival, access, weather/fog, coastal road conditions, home-specific tips) and check in during the stay

Keep conversations organized and ensure no guest is left waiting or confused

Ensure every guest experience feels personal and thoughtfully handled

Welcome outreach (required for every reservation)

Send a personalized welcome text to find out what, if anything, they are celebrating

Confirm access and comfort, offer help, and document any concerns quickly

Identify opportunities to make the guest's stay a memorable coastal experience

Workorders and coordination (Breezeway)

Create workorders fast when issues arise and confirm vendor/team acknowledgment

Track progress, follow up, and close the loop with guests and the local team

Keep notes and task status clean so handoffs are seamless

Cleaning scheduling and turnovers (Breezeway)

Coordinate turn cleaning schedules and special requests

Ensure all turns are scheduled a minimum of one week prior to booking and confirm scheduled cleaner by 6:00pm Pacific the night prior to a scheduled cleaning and communicate key notes to cleaners



Documentation and handoffs

Maintain accurate property notes and updates

Close out open items before shift end and hand off active issues with clear context

Monthly SLA Standards (required for bonus eligibility)

Guest messages answered within 5 minutes during your shift (Akia)

Phone calls answered within 30 seconds during your shift

No open guest messages left at shift end; clean handoffs with clear notes

Workorders created promptly and vendor/team acknowledgment confirmed quickly



Local expertise

Become an expert on Sea Ranch, Gualala, and the Sonoma Coast, including seasonal rhythms, coastal weather and fog patterns, Highway 1 road conditions, and local norms.

Learn the best restaurants, cafes, shops, activities, and experiences in each market so you can offer personalized, concierge-level recommendations that make each stay special.

Know our homes in detail: complete Matterport and photo walkthroughs; learn layouts, bedding, amenities, quirks, parking, access instructions, recreation pass usage, and any "good to know" details for guests.

Stay current on local events and updates by checking event calendars, tourism sites, and community pages (including Sea Ranch Association updates and relevant local
 groups).

Use your local and property knowledge proactively to help guests plan better stays, avoid common issues, and feel confidently looked after from booking to checkout.



What we look for

Excellent spoken English and good written english with a warm, helpful tone. Spoken English is the most important requirement.

Hospitality mindset (you enjoy caring for people, not just closing tickets)

Strong ownership and follow-through, especially on busy days

Detail-oriented and eager to learn homes, markets, and local context

No prior experience with Guesty, Breezeway, Akia, or Zoom Phone is required. We will teach you the software and the process.

Reliable internet and a quiet, professional work environment



How to apply

Please submit the following:

Resume/CV

2-minute video recording introducing yourself and your experience (English)

Speedtest.net result (screenshot)

Short written samples: How would you respond to the following guest messages?

"The hot tub isn't heating. Can you help?"

"Can we request a late checkout tomorrow?"

"We're staying in Sea Ranch — any recommendations for a great dinner spot nearby?"

Short written samples: These three guests message you at the same time. In what order would you respond and why?

"We can't get into the home, the code isn't working."

"The Wi-Fi is slow and we need it for work."

"Can we check out one hour later?"

Part-time with option for fulltime.

Monday: Grant research, eligibility checks, and deadline planning.



Wednesday: Grant writing and supporting documents.



Thursday: Fundraising, sponsor outreach, and event coordination.



Friday: Finalize approved applications, follow up, update trackers, and report progress.

Verify eligibility, restrictions, funding amounts, deadlines, and requirements.



Maintain a prioritized grant pipeline and calendar.

Gather budgets, program information, outcome data, and required documents.



Prepare applications for leadership review and submit approved applications.



Track submissions, communications, follow-ups, and decisions.



Maintain reusable organizational materials.



Track award requirements and help prepare reports.



Fundraising Responsibilities



Research potential sponsors, donors, and community partners.



Prepare sponsorship packages and outreach materials for approval.



Conduct approved outreach and track responses and commitments.

title: AI Growth Builder & Outbound Marketer (we build our own): property tech + new SaaS, remote
description:
AI Growth Builder and Outbound Marketer (global outreach), remote



The short version

We are a European property-tech group, and we are building something bigger. We need someone who uses AI to reach the right people in every market and turns that reach into real action on our platforms: agents listing their properties and getting viewings booked, agencies coming on board. Think AI-driven
, AI calling, and social outreach that gets people to like and share, country by country, in the local language. Important: we build and own our systems. We are not looking for someone who rents a pile of subscriptions, we want someone who builds the engine with us so we own it and reuse it. On top of that, you can pick up the broader marketing work too: content, social, basic SEO, paid, analytics.



Who we are

We run several live rental and property platforms in the European market on one shared codebase, plus a new SaaS for the staffing and recruitment sector. We move fast, we test thoroughly, and we reward people who prove results.



How we work (important)

- We build and own our tools. We prefer building over renting. Less vendor lock-in, more control, and everything we build we reuse across our platforms.

- That means working at the level of APIs, your own scripts, and your own automations, not clicking together a stack of expensive closed services.

- You build it once, we own it, and it keeps paying off across every channel and every country.



What you will do (the core)

- Build AI-powered, multi-channel outreach that we own and that scales worldwide, market by market:
 at volume, AI calling, social, and WhatsApp where it fits.

- For the property platform: reach real estate agents in every market and bring them onto the platform, listing their properties and getting viewings booked. The AI calls and messages carry one clear call to action: visit the site and get started.

- For the SaaS: reach staffing and recruitment agencies and get them on board and active in the same way.

- It is one engine for both products. You build it once and it runs for property and for staffing, country by country.

- Make it work in any language. Build a reliable localization approach so the outreach reads native in each market, using AI translation with quality control and native review where it matters. Rough machine translation does not cut it; the message has to feel local, not foreign.

- Drive social amplification: get agents and agencies to follow, like, and share our content, so reach compounds.

- Build the lead data, sequences, and automations yourself, and keep them deliverable and legal in every market you touch: GDPR in Europe, anti-spam laws such as CAN-SPAM, and local rules on
 and automated calling. Warmed domains, clear opt-out, and consent where it is required. Compliance and deliverability are part of the job, not an afterthought.

- Measure everything: replies, signups, activations, and double down on what works.



What you will do (the bonus, all-round)

- Content and social management, basic SEO, paid campaigns, simple design, reporting.



How you build it (we like builders, not renters)

- Comfortable wiring up LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic) in your own workflows.

- Comfortable with self-hostable automation (for example n8n) and your own scripts over closed SaaS where it makes sense.

- Can build your own lead data, localization, and outreach pipeline instead of depending on one paid platform.

- For AI calling, you wire telephony and voice models yourself rather than relying on a closed black box.

If you already build your own automations instead of renting them, tell us. That is exactly who we want.



Who you are

- You think in systems and you build and own them.

- You have grown something real and can show it, with a number.

- You are comfortable with volume, testing, and iteration.

- You write clear English, and you have a proven way to make outreach read natively in many other languages (AI localization with quality control, native review where it matters). You do not rely on rough machine translation.

- You respect the law in each country you reach into, and you treat compliance as part of doing it well, not a brake. You know that automated calling in particular is tightly regulated and you handle it carefully, market by market.

- You are self-starting and reliable, and you keep brands safe (no spammy shortcuts that get domains blacklisted).



The deal

- Remote, full-time preferred. We start at a fair entry rate and raise it quickly for people who prove results.

- We test with a small paid task first, then move fast for the right person.

- As we scale this across both products and more markets, there is room for it to grow into more than one role.



How to apply (please read)

1. Start your message with the word GROWTH so I know you read this.

2. In a few lines, answer this: how would you reach 10,000 real estate agents in one country using AI, end to end, how would you keep it legal and deliverable there (think GDPR, anti-spam, and rules on automated calling), how would you make the outreach read natively in that country's language, and which parts would you build yourself versus rent?

3. Add one example of something you have grown, with a number.

Applications that skip these get less attention. We reply to serious ones quickly.

title: Outreach Assistant from the Wellness and Retreat Industry (start today, full time until 21 October)

READ THIS FIRST



Do not apply unless you have worked in retreats, wellness, yoga, fitness or sports, and your social media profiles show it. This job is messaging retreat owners from your own accounts. They will look at your profile before they reply. If your profile doesn't look like someone from their world, they won't answer, and the job doesn't work. Applications without profile links will be deleted unread.





ABOUT THE JOB



I'm co-hosting the International Retreat Conference, a free online event for retreat owners on 22 October. Retreat owners get a free ticket by taking a short quiz about how they sell their retreats. You will find retreat owners on social media and message them personally, every day, until 21 October, introducing yourself as someone helping me with the conference.





THE GOAL



100 retreat owners signed up through your outreach by 21 October. If you hit the goal, or get close with good quality work, there may be ongoing outreach work after the conference.





YOUR PROFILE MUST SHOW



- Work history in retreats, wellness, yoga, fitness, sports or wellness travel, for example a retreat company, yoga or fitness studio, wellness brand, spa, sports club or travel agency

- A headline or bio that says what you do in that industry

- Posts or content about wellness, retreats, fitness or sport from the last 6 months

- Connections or followers who are in that industry

WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Find retreat owners and organisers on Instagram,
 (pages and groups), LinkedIn, and anywhere else they are active

- Check each person runs retreats: a website, recent retreat posts or upcoming dates

- Send short, personal messages from your own accounts, using the scripts I give you, adjusted to each person

- Reply to responses the same day and send the quiz link to anyone interested

- Log every person you contact in a shared Google Sheet: name, platform, profile link, date contacted, reply, link sent

- Send me an end-of-day report on Slack: messages sent, replies received, links sent, sign-ups so far





DAILY TARGETS



- At least 80 new personal messages a day across all platforms, kept within each platform's safe limits so no account gets restricted

- Every reply answered within a few hours during your shift

- No copy-and-paste spam. Every message uses the person's name and one real detail about their retreats





DATES AND HOURS



- Start: today, 9 October

- Last day: 21 October

- Full time, 8 hours a day, including weekends

- Your hours must overlap with UK and European daytime, and US mornings, when retreat owners reply





PAY



- USD 300 for the 13 days, paid by Wise: half on 15 October, half on 22 October

- USD 1 bonus for every retreat owner who completes the quiz through your personal tracking link





HOW TO APPLY



Follow every step exactly. Missing any step means your application is deleted.



1. The first line of your application must be: RETREAT OUTREACH 22 OCT

2. Paste the links to your LinkedIn, Instagram and
 profiles. All three, as full links.

3. In two sentences, tell me what you did in retreats, wellness, fitness or sports, and where.

4. Find one real retreat owner online and paste the link to their website or profile.

5. Write the first message you would send that person, in under 300 characters, using a real detail from their page.

6. Tell me which platforms you've done outreach on, and roughly how many messages a day you sent.

7. Confirm you can start today and work every day, including weekends, until 21 October.

8. Send a 1-minute voice note or Loom introducing yourself.

9. End your application with the word: Ibiza
